passages.content: Summer holiday is coming. I’m very happy. I have a busy but happy plan. First, I will finish my holiday homework in the first week. Then, I will go to Qingdao with my parents by plane. We will go to the beach and swim in the sea. I want to take many photos there. I also want to eat seafood. After the trip, I will learn to draw pictures. I like drawing very much. I think I will have a great summer holiday.

questions.question:
What’s coming? (   )
A．Winter holiday.
B．Summer holiday.
C．Weekend.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：什么假期即将到来？根据“Summer holiday is coming.”可知暑假即将到来。

questions.question:
I will finish my homework ______. (   )
A．in the first week
B．in the second week
C．today
questions.explanation: 句意：我将在______完成我的作业。根据“First, I will finish my holiday homework in the first week.”可知是在第一周。

questions.question:
I will go to Qingdao with my ______. (   )
A．friends
B．teachers
C．parents
questions.explanation: 句意：我将和我的______去青岛。根据“I will go to Qingdao with my parents by plane.”可知是和父母。

questions.question:
We will go to Qingdao ______. (   )
A．by bus
B．by plane
C．on foot
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将______去青岛。根据“I will go to Qingdao with my parents by plane.”可知是乘飞机。

questions.question:
I will learn to ______ after the trip. (   )
A．swim
B．draw pictures
C．speak English
questions.explanation: 句意：旅行后，我将学习______。根据“After the trip, I will learn to draw pictures.”可知是学画画。

passages.content: It’s a fine day today. The sun is shining. The sky is blue. There are many people in the park. Some children are playing games. Some boys are playing football. Some girls are skipping. An old man is reading a book under a big tree. A young woman is listening to music. A little girl is drawing a picture. She is drawing flowers and birds. She likes drawing very much. There is a lake in the park. Some ducks are swimming in the lake. They are very happy. People are having a good time in the park.

questions.question:
What’s the weather like today? (    )
A．It’s rainy.
B．It’s sunny.
C．It’s cloudy.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：今天天气如何？It’s rainy.今天是有雨的。It’s sunny.今天是晴朗的。It’s cloudy.今天是多云的。根据文中“It’s a fine day today. The sun is shining.”可知今天的天气很好，是晴朗的。

questions.question:
What are the boys doing in the park? (    )
A．They’re playing football.
B．They’re skipping.
C．They’re playing games.
questions.explanation: 句意：男孩们正在公园里干什么？They’re playing football.他们正在踢足球。They’re skipping.他们正在跳。They’re playing games.他们正在玩游戏。根据文中“Some boys are playing football.”可知男孩们正在踢足球。

questions.question:
Where is the old man reading a book? (    )
A．Under a small tree.
B．Under a big tree.
C．Near the lake.
questions.explanation: 句意：老人正在哪里读书？Under a small tree.在小树下。Under a big tree.在大树下。Near the lake.在湖附近。根据文中“An old man is reading a book under a big tree.”可知老人在大树下读书。

questions.question:
What is the little girl doing? (    )
A．She’s listening to music.
B．She’s drawing a picture.
C．She’s swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个小女孩正在干什么？She’s listening to music.她正在听音乐。She’s drawing a picture.她正在画画。She’s swimming.她正在游泳。根据文中“A little girl is drawing a picture.”可知这个小女孩正在画画。

questions.question:
What are the ducks doing? (    )
A．They’re flying.
B．They’re running.
C．They’re swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：鸭子们正在干什么？They’re flying.它们正在飞。They’re running.它们正在跑。They’re swimming.它们正在游泳。根据文中“Some ducks are swimming in the lake.”可知鸭子们正在湖里游泳。

passages.content: Hello, everyone! My name is Lucy. I’m a student from Grade Six. Today is Sunday. The weather is sunny and warm. I’m going to have a picnic with my family in the park. My father is going to buy some cola and hamburgers. My mother is going to prepare some fruit and sandwiches. My little brother wants to fly a kite. We are going to meet at the park gate at nine o’clock in the morning. I think we will have a good time.

questions.question:
What day is it today? (   )
A．Monday.
B．Sunday.
C．Saturday.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：今天是星期几？根据“Today is Sunday.”，可知今天星期日。

questions.question:
What’s the weather like today? (   )
A．Sunny and warm.
B．Cloudy and cool.
C．Rainy and cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天天气怎么样？Sunny and warm.晴朗暖和。Cloudy and cool.多云且凉爽。Rainy and cold.多雨且寒冷。根据“The weather is sunny and warm.”，可知今天天气晴朗暖和。

questions.question:
Lucy is going to have a picnic with her ______. (   )
A．friends
B．classmates
C．family
questions.explanation: 句意：露西将和她的____去野餐？根据“I’m going to have a picnic with my family in the park.”，可知露西将和家人去野餐。

questions.question:
Lucy’s father is going to buy ______. (   )
A．fruit and sandwiches
B．cola and hamburgers
C．a kite
questions.explanation: 句意：露西的爸爸将去买____？fruit and sandwiches水果和三明治，cola and hamburgers可乐和汉堡包，a kite一个风筝。根据“My father is going to buy some cola and hamburgers.”，可知露西爸爸将去买一些可乐和汉堡包。

questions.question:
When are they going to meet at the park gate? (   )
A．At eight o’clock.
B．At nine o’clock.
C．At ten o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们将什么时候在公园门口见面？根据“We are going to meet at the park gate at nine o’clock in the morning.”，可知他们将九点在公园门口见面。

passages.content: Last Saturday, Tom went to the supermarket with his mother. His mother wanted to buy some food for dinner. Tom wanted a cola and a hot dog. The cola was two dollars and the hot dog was one dollar. They also bought some meat and vegetables. On their way home, it started to rain. They ran quickly to get on the bus. When they got home, Tom was a little wet, but he was happy. He helped his mother cook dinner. They had a delicious meal together.

questions.question:
Where did Tom go last Saturday? (   )
A．The park.
B．The supermarket.
C．The zoo.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：汤姆上周六去了哪里？The park.公园。The supermarket.超市。The zoo.动物园。由文中“Last Saturday, Tom went to the supermarket with his mother.”可知上周六，汤姆和他妈妈去了超市。

questions.question:
What did Tom want to buy? (   )
A．A cola and a hot dog.
B．Meat and vegetables.
C．A book and a pen.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆想买什么？A cola and a hot dog.一杯可乐和一个热狗。Meat and vegetables.肉和蔬菜。A book and a pen.一本书和一支笔。由文中“Tom wanted a cola and a hot dog.”可知汤姆想要一杯可乐和一个热狗。

questions.question:
How much was the cola? (   )
A．One dollar.
B．Two dollars.
C．Three dollars.
questions.explanation: 句意：可乐多少钱？One dollar.一美元。Two dollars.两美元。Three dollars.三美元。由文中“The cola was two dollars and the hot dog was one dollar. ”可知可乐两美元。

questions.question:
What happened on their way home? (   )
A．They lost their bag.
B．It started to rain.
C．They met a friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们回家的路上发生了什么？They lost their bag. 他们丢了包。It started to rain.天开始下雨了。They met a friend.他们遇到了一个朋友。由文中“On their way home, it started to rain.”可知在他们回家的路上，天开始下雨了。

questions.question:
What did Tom do when he got home? (   )
A．He watched TV.
B．He did his homework.
C．He helped his mother cook dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆到家后做了什么？He watched TV.他看电视了。He did his homework.他做作业了。He helped his mother cook dinner.他帮妈妈做晚餐了。由文中“He helped his mother cook dinner.”可知他帮妈妈做了晚饭。

passages.content: It’s Sunday. Li Mei and her friends go to the zoo. They get on the bus at 9 o’clock. Li Mei says to her friends, “Don’t push. Let’s wait in line.” On the bus, an old grandma gets on. Li Mei gives her seat to the grandma. The grandma says, “Thank you, little girl.” Li Mei says, “You’re welcome.” When they get to the zoo, they see many animals. Li Mei says, “Don’t walk on the grass and don’t feed the animals too much.” Her friends all say, “OK.” They watch the pandas and deer, and take many pictures. They have a happy day.

questions.question:
Li Mei and her friends go to the zoo on ______. (     )
A．Monday
B．Sunday
C．Saturday
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：李梅和她的朋友们在____去动物园。根据“It’s Sunday. Li Mei and her friends go to the zoo.”可知是周日。

questions.question:
They get on the bus at ______. (     )
A．8 o’clock
B．9 o’clock
C．10 o’clock
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在___上公交车。根据“They get on the bus at 9 o’clock.”可知是九点。

questions.question:
Li Mei gives her seat to ______. (     )
A．a little boy
B．an old grandpa
C．an old grandma
questions.explanation: 句意：李梅把她的座位给了____。根据“On the bus, an old grandma gets on. Li Mei gives her seat to the grandma.”可知是一个老奶奶。

questions.question:
What does Li Mei say to her friends in the zoo? (     )
A．Don’t wait in line.
B．Don’t walk on the grass.
C．Shout loudly.
questions.explanation: 句意：在动物园里李梅和她的朋友们说什么了？Don’t wait in line.不要排队。Don’t walk on the grass.不要踩踏草地。Shout loudly.大声喊。根据“Li Mei says, “Don’t walk on the grass and don’t feed the animals too much.””可知是不要踩踏草地和喂动物。

questions.question:
They ______ in the zoo and have a happy day. (     )
A．watched animals and took pictures
B．fed the pandas too much
C．walked on the grass
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在动物园里____并度过了开心的一天。watched animals and took pictures看了动物并拍了照，fed the pandas too much给熊猫喂了很多，walked on the grass在草地上走。根据“They watch the pandas and deer, and take many pictures.”可知是看熊猫和鹿，并拍了很多照片。

passages.content:
Long long ago, there was a farmer. He had many nice horses.

One night, a big horse ran away from the farm. “A bad thing can become a good thing.” the old man said.

Three months later, the big horse came home with a good horse. “A good thing can become a bad thing.” the old man said quietly.

The old man’s son loved the good horse. He learned to ride. One day, he fell down from the horse and broke his leg. He was sad. “A bad thing can become a good thing.” the old man just said.

A year later, a war（战争）started. All young men in the country had to fight in the war. Lots of them died. However, the old man’s son didn’t join the war because of his broken leg. “A good thing may become a bad thing. Who knows?” the old man said to himself.

questions.question:
What did the farmer have? (   )
A．Nice cows.
B．Nice horses.
C．Nice goats.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：这个农民有什么？A好牛。B好马。C好山羊。由文中“He had many nice horses.” 可知他有很多好马。故选B。

questions.question:
What is the meaning（意思）of “broke”? (   )
A．使骨折
B．使跌倒
C．使痛苦
questions.explanation: 句意：“broke”的意思是什么？根据上下文，农民的儿子从马上摔下来，broke his leg应理解为“骨折”。故选A。

questions.question:
Why did the old man say “A bad thing can become a good thing.” after a big horse ran away from the farm? (   )
A．Because the big horse was not good.
B．Because the big horse came home with a good horse.
C．Because he didn’t like that horse.
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么这个老人在一匹大马从农场跑走后说“坏事可以变成好事。”？A因为大马不好。B因为大马带了一匹好马回家。C因为他不喜欢这匹马。由文中“Three months later, the big horse came home with a good horse.” 可知三个月后大马带了一匹好马回家印证了老人的话。故选B。

questions.question:
“A good thing may become a bad thing.” Here “bad thing” refers to ______. (   )
A．His son learned to ride.
B．His son loved the good horse.
C．His son fell from the horse and broke his leg.
questions.explanation: 句意：“好事可能变成坏事。”这里的“坏事”指的是_____。A他的儿子学习骑马。B他的儿子喜欢这匹好马。C他的儿子从马上摔下来摔坏了他的腿。由文章内容可知他儿子因骑马摔断腿是“好事变坏事”的体现。故选C。

questions.question:
Can you give the story a Chinese title? (   )
A．亡羊补牢
B．塞翁失马
C．杞人忧天
questions.explanation: 句意：你能给这个故事起个中文标题吗？根据文章内容可知这篇文章是中国成语“塞翁失马，焉知非福”的典故。故选B。

passages.content: When you are in England, you must be very careful on the street because the traffic(来往车辆)drives on the left. Before you cross a street, you must look to the right first and then look to the left. If the traffic light is red, the traffic must stop. Then people on foot can cross the street carefully! If the traffic light is green, the traffic can go. People on foot mustn’t cross the street. In the morning and in the evening when people go to or come from work, the streets are very busy. The traffic is the most dangerous at that time. When you want to take a bus in England, you have to be careful, too. Always remember the traffic moves on the left, or you will go the wrong way. In many English cities, there are big buses with two floors. You can sit on the second floor. From there you can see the city very well. It’s very interesting!

questions.question:
The title(题目) of the passage is ________. (    )
A．Traffic Rules in England
B．Home Rules in England
C．School Rules in England
questions.explanation: 句意：文章题目是______。A英国交通规则，B英国家庭规则，C英国学校规则。根据全文介绍的内容是英国的交通规则，故选A。

questions.question:
In England, drivers drive cars on the ________. (    )
A．right
B．left
C．right first then left
questions.explanation: 句意：在英国，司机在______驾驶汽车。A右边，B左边，C先右后左，根据“When you are in England, you must be very careful on the street because the traffic drives on the left. ”可知在英国，司机在左边驾驶汽车，故选B。

questions.question:
If the traffic light is red, the traffic must ______. (    )
A．go
B．look
C．stop
questions.explanation: 句意：如果交通灯是红色，车辆必须______。A走，B看，C停止。根据“If the traffic light is red, the traffic must stop.”可知红灯必须停止，故选C。

questions.question:
If the traffic light is green, the traffic can go. People on foot ________ cross the street. (    )
A．should
B．mustn’t
C．can
questions.explanation: 句意：如果交通灯是绿色，车辆可以通行。行人______过马路。A应该，B禁止，C可以。根据“People on foot mustn’t cross the street.”可知绿灯时行人禁止过马路，故选B。

questions.question:
When you want to take a bus in England, you ________ be careful, too. (    )
A．can’t
B．don’t
C．must
questions.explanation: 句意：在英国乘坐公交车时，你______也要小心。A不能，B不要，C必须。根据“When you want to take a bus in England, you have to be careful, too. ”可知在英国乘坐公交车时，你必须也要小心，故选C。

passages.content:
阅读短文，选择正确答案。
An insect exhibition
Date: May 1st-31st
Place: Star Town Museum
Show: All kinds of insects from different countries
Time: Mon.-Fri. 10:00 am-4:00 pm
     Sat.-Sun. 9:00 am-5:00 pm
Tickets: Adults: ¥20
       Students: ¥15
       Free for children under 12
Telephone number: 87659235
Special gift!
Come to the exhibition on 1st. May and get a free picture of insects

questions.question:
We can see _______ in the insect exhibition. (     )
A．some paintings
B．some pictures of butterflies only
C．some interesting insects
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以在昆虫展览中看到_______。A一些画作，B仅仅一些蝴蝶的图片，C一些有趣的昆虫，根据短文 “Show: All kinds of insects from different countries” 可知在昆虫展览中能看到各种来自不同国家的昆虫，故选C。

questions.question:
You are going to see the exhibition with your 14-year–old daughter, you will have to pay _______. (     )
A．15 yuan
B．20 yuan
C．35 yuan
questions.explanation: 句意：你打算和你 14 岁的女儿一起去看这个展览，你将不得不支付_______。A15 元，B20 元，C35 元，根据短文“Tickets: Adults: ¥20，Students: ¥15”，可知成人票价 20 元，学生票价 15 元。14岁女儿是学生，所以花费是 20 + 15 = 35 元，故选C。

questions.question:
We can book tickets _______. (     )
A．by making a phone call
B．by sending an e-mail
C．by writing a letter
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以_______预订门票。A通过打电话，B通过发送电子邮件，C通过写信，根据短文 “Telephone number: 87659235” 给出了电话号码，可以通过打电话订票，故选A。

questions.question:
We can go to the exhibition at _______ on Sunday. (     )
A．8:30
B．10:30
C．all day
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以在周日的_______去看这个展览。A8 点 30 分，B10 点 30 分，C一整天，根据短文“Time: Mon.-Fri. 10:00 am - 4:00 pm，Sat.-Sun. 9:00 am - 5:00 pm” 可知周日的开放时间是上午 9 点到下午 5 点，故选B。

questions.question:
If you go to the exhibition on 1st May, you can get _______. (     )
A．a book
B．a ticket
C．a present
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你在 5 月 1 日去看这个展览，你可以得到_______。A一本书，B一张门票，C一份礼物，根据短文“Special gift! Come to the exhibition on 1st May and get a free picture of insects.” 可知5月1日去展览可以得到一份免费的昆虫图片作为礼物，故选C。

passages.content:
It’s very helpful to know something about the British meals before going to the UK. In many British homes, people eat four meals a day. They are breakfast, lunch, tea and dinner.

Breakfast takes place at any time from 7:00 to 9:00 in the morning. They usually have eggs, bread with butter(黄油), cheese(奶酪) and so on. British people drink tea or coffee at breakfast. Lunch comes at 1:00 p.m.

It can be a hamburger or a three-course(三道菜) meal. The first course is soup. The next is often meat or fish with vegetables. Then come fruits: apples, pears, bananas and so on. But not all British people eat like that. And these meals are usually simple. Afternoon tea is between 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. Dinner is at about 7:30 p.m.

questions.question:
British people ________ at breakfast. (    )
A．drink tea or coffee
B．eat fruits
C．drink juice
questions.explanation: 句意：英国人早餐_______。A喝茶或咖啡，B吃水果，C喝果汁。根据 “British people drink tea or coffee at breakfast.”可知英国人早餐喝茶或咖啡，故选A。

questions.question:
The first course is ________. (    )
A．meat
B．fish
C．soup
questions.explanation: 句意：第一道菜是_______。A肉，B鱼，C汤。根据“The first course is soup.”可知第一道菜是汤，故选C。

questions.question:
British people’s meals are breakfast, lunch, _______ and dinner. (    )
A．fish
B．tea
C．fruits
questions.explanation: 句意：英国人的餐食包括早餐、午餐、_______和晚餐。A鱼，B茶，C水果。根据 “They are breakfast, lunch, tea and dinner.”可知英国人的餐食包括早餐、午餐、茶点和晚餐，故选B。

questions.question:
You can have afternoon tea at ________ p.m. (    )
A．5:30
B．2:30
C．4:30
questions.explanation: 句意：你(你们)在_______喝下午茶。根据 “Afternoon tea is between 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.”可知下午茶时间在下午4点到5点之间，故选C。

questions.question:
The Chinese meaning of “so on” is “_________”. (    )
A．在……上
B．等等
C．如此
questions.explanation: 句意：“so on”的中文意思是______。根据“They usually have eggs, bread with butter, cheese and so on.”结合语境可知意思是“等等”，表示列举未尽，故选B。

passages.content:
Mr Black likes fish very much. He often buys some fish in the shop and take home for dinner. His wife, Mrs Black often asks her friends to their home to have lunch and eat fish.

One day, when Mr Black comes home in the evening, he can not find his fish. And Mrs Black says their cat ate the fish. Mr Black is very angry. He takes the cat to the shop near their house to weigh the cat. He says, "You see, my fish is one kilo. And the cat is one kilo, too. My fish is here. Then where is my cat？"

questions.question:
Mr Black likes ______. (   )
A．eating fish
B．going fishing
C．catching fish
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：布莱克先生喜欢  。A吃鱼，B去钓鱼，C抓鱼。根据文中“He often buys some fish in the shop and take home for dinner.”可知布莱克先生经常买鱼回家晚餐吃，他喜欢吃鱼，故选A。

questions.question:
Mr Black often eats fish for ______. (   )
A．lunch
B．dinner
C．breakfast
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克先生经常  吃鱼。A午餐，B晚餐，C早餐。根据文中“He often buys some fish in the shop and take home for dinner.”可知布莱克先生经常买鱼回家晚餐吃，故选B。

questions.question:
What does Mrs Black often do? ______. (   )
A．She asks her friends to their home to have lunch.
B．She asks her friends to their home to have dinner.
C．She asks her friends to their home to have breakfast.
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克太太经常干什么？A她邀请她的朋友们来家吃午餐。B她邀请她的朋友们来家吃晚餐。C她邀请她的朋友们来家吃早餐。根据文中“His wife, Mrs Black often asks her friends to their home to have lunch and eat fish.”可知布莱克太太经常邀请她的朋友们来家吃午餐，故选A。

questions.question:
Why is Mr Black angry? ______. (   )
A．He doesn’t like his wife, Mrs Black.
B．He doesn’t like Mrs Black’s friends.
C．He finds his fish is lost.
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克先生为什么生气？A他不喜欢布莱克太太。B他不喜欢布莱克太太的朋友。C他发现他的鱼丢了。根据文中“One day, when Mr Black comes home in the evening, he can not find his fish. And Mrs Black says their cat ate the fish. Mr Black is very angry.”可知布莱克晚上回家找不到他的鱼，他很生气，故选C。

questions.question:
Where is Mr Black’s fish? ______. (   )
A．His wife and her friends ate the fish.
B．His fish ran away.
C．His cat ate the fish.
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克先生的鱼在哪里？A他的太太和她的朋友们把鱼吃了。B他的鱼跑了。C他的猫吃了鱼。根据文中“And Mrs Black says their cat ate the fish.”和“You see, my fish is one kilo. And the cat is one kilo, too.”可知布莱克太太欺骗布莱克先生说鱼被猫吃了，实际上是她和她的朋友们吃了，故选A。

passages.content:
Alice and her mom left their house on Pike Street to go to school. Alice put on her safety belt (安全带). About the same time, Kay and her mom left their house on the l st Street.

On the way to school, Kay jumped up and down on the seat in the car. She had forgotten to wear her safety belt. Both moms turned into the school parking lot at the same time, and they crashed (碰撞) into each other! Alice was not hurt. Her safety belt kept her in her seat. But, Kay fell forward and bumped her head hard! She cried and cried. She had to go to the hospital and get an X-ray.

Kay got well in a day or two, but she learned an important lesson!

questions.question:
Who does not live on the 1st Street? (   )
A．Kay.
B．Kay’s mom.
C．Alice’s mom.
questions.explanation: 句意：谁不住在第一街？A凯。B凯的妈妈。C爱丽丝的妈妈。根据“Alice and her mom left their house on Pike Street to go to school.”可知爱丽丝的妈妈住在派克街，故选C。

questions.question:
How did Kay go to school? (   )
A．By bike.
B．By car.
C．By bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯怎样去上学？A骑自行车，B坐汽车。C乘公共汽车。根据“On the way to school, Kay jumped up and down on the seat in the car.”可知凯坐汽车，故选B。

questions.question:
What happened in the school parking lot? (   )
A．Alice’s mom and Kay’s mom crashed into each other.
B．Alice and Kay were late.
C．Alice’s mom and Kay’s mom said hello to each other.
questions.explanation: 句意：学校停车场发生了什么？A爱丽丝的妈妈和凯的妈妈撞到了一起。B爱丽丝和凯迟到了。C爱丽丝的妈妈和凯的妈妈互相打招呼。根据“Both moms turned into the school parking lot at the same time, and they crashed (碰撞) into each other!”可知是撞到了一起，故选A。

questions.question:
Which is NOT true? (   )
A．Alice didn’t get hurt.
B．Kay bumped her arm.
C．Kay got an X -ray in the hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：哪一个不是正确的？A爱丽丝没有受伤。B凯撞到了她的胳膊。C凯在医院接受了 X 光检查。根据“But, Kay fell forward and bumped her head hard!”可知凯撞到了头，故选B。

questions.question:
What lesson did Kay learn? (   )
A．She should not cry.
B．She should jump on the seat.
C．She should wear her safety belt.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯学到了什么课？A她不应该哭。B她应该在座位上跳。C她应该系安全带。根据“She had forgotten to wear her safety belt.”和“But, Kay fell forward and bumped her head hard!”可知因为没有系安全带撞到了头，所以应是学到了要系安全带，故选C。

passages.content:
Beijing is the capital of China. It’s in the north of China. It’s one the biggest cities in the world. There are many places of interest there. You can go to the Great Wall, the Palace Museum and the Summer Palace.

Xinjiang is in the west of China. It is famous for grapes, melons and pears. The fruit there is very juicy and sweet. People there are friendly and hard-working. They’re very good at singing and dancing.

Tibet is in the west of China. It’s cold and dry. There are snow-capped (顶部被雪覆盖) mountains there. There are many temples in Tibet. Its capital is Lhasa. It’s famous for the Potala Palace. (布达拉宫).

Hangzhou is a beautiful city in Zhejiang Province. It’s in the south of China. It’s famous for the West Lake(西湖) and silk. You can row on the lake. You can buy silk clothes and silk scarves at a low price there.

questions.question:
The passage talks about ________ famous places in China. (   )
A．three
B．four
C．five
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：这篇文章谈论了______个中国的著名地方。A三，B四，C五，根据全文可知谈论了四个中国著名的地方，故选B。

questions.question:
The underlined word “juicy” means “______” in Chinese. (   )
A．多汁的
B．酸的
C．苦的
questions.explanation: 句意：划线单词“juicy”的中文意思是“_______”。根据短文语境可知juicy的意思是多汁的，故选A。

questions.question:
Where is Tibet? (   )
A．It’s in the east of China.
B．It’s in the west of China.
C．It’s in the middle of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：西藏在哪里？A它在中国的东部。B它在中国的西部。C它在中国中部。根据“Tibet is in the west of China.”，可知西藏在中国的西部，故选B。

questions.question:
The silk clothes and silk scarves in Hangzhou are _________. (   )
A．expensive(昂贵的)
B．cheap(便宜的)
C．big
questions.explanation: 句意：杭州的丝绸衣服和丝绸围巾是_______。根据“You can buy silk clothes and silk scarves at a low price there.”，可知杭州的丝绸衣服和丝绸围巾是便宜的，故选B。

questions.question:
Which one is WRONG(错误的)? (   )
A．The weather in Tibet is cold and dry.
B．People in Xinjiang are friendly and hard-working.
C．The Summer Palace in Hangzhou is beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：哪一项是错误的？A西藏的天气寒冷干燥。B新疆人民友好勤劳。C杭州的颐和园很漂亮。根据第一段可知颐和园在北京，故选C。

passages.content:
How are you? Now I want to tell you something exciting. Last week I had a trip to Mount Tai with my friends. On Tuesday, we went to Tai’an, a city at the foot of the mountain. At about one o’clock early the next morning, we started to climb the mountain. It took us about four and a half hours to get to the top. The mountain is covered with trees. I didn’t see such a beautiful place before. “Look! The sun is going to rise!” My friend Jim shouted. We had a good time there. After lunch, we started walking back. We got to the tour hotel at about four in the afternoon.

Thank you very much for your last letter. Hope to hear from you soon.

questions.question:
This letter is for ________. (   )
A．Nancy
B．Wu Tong
C．Jim
questions.explanation: 句意：这封信是给_______。A南希，B吴东，C吉姆。根据“Dear Nancy,”可知这封信是写给南希的，故选A。

questions.question:
We climbed Mount Tai ________. (   )
A．on Tuesday
B．on Wednesday
C．on Thursday
questions.explanation: 句意：我们__________爬泰山。A在星期二，B在星期三，C在星期四。根据“On Tuesday, we went to Tai’an, a city at the foot of the mountain. At about one o’clock early the next morning, we started to climb the mountain.”可知我们周二到达泰山山脚，第二天凌晨一点开始爬山，可以推断我们周三去爬泰山，故选B。

questions.question:
We got to the top of Mount Tai________. (   )
A．at about four thirty in the morning
B．at about half past five in the morning
C．at about five thirty in the afternoon
questions.explanation: 句意：我们__________到达泰山山顶。A大约早上四点半，B大约早上五点半，C大约下午五点半。根据“At about one o’clock early the next morning, we started to climb the mountain. It took us about four and a half hours to get to the top.”可知我们凌晨一点开始爬山，大约花了四个半小时到达山顶，可以推断到达山顶的时间是早上五点半，故选B。

questions.question:
We got to the hotel ________. (   )
A．the next day
B．in the morning
C．in the afternoon
questions.explanation: 句意：我们___________到达酒店。A第二天，B在上午，C在下午。根据“We got to the tour hotel at about four in the afternoon.”可知我们下午到酒店，故选C。

passages.content:
Confucius (孔子) is travelling to the east. He sees two children arguing (争论).

“I think,” says one child, “the sun is near to us at daybreak and far away at noon.” The other thinks that the sun is far away at dawn (黎明) and near at noon. “When the sun appears (出现),” says the child, “it is as big as a wheel (轮子), but at noon it is only like a plate or a bowl. Isn’t it true that objects (物体) far away seem smaller while those nearby seem bigger?”

“When the sun appears,” says the other child, “it is cool, but at noon it is as hot as putting your hand in hot water. Isn’t it true that things nearer to us is hotter and things farther away is cooler?”

Confucius hears these, but he doesn’t know which of them is right. The children laughed and said, “Who says you know so much?”

questions.question:
Where is Confucius travelling to? (   )
A．East.
B．West.
C．North.
questions.explanation: 句意：孔子要去哪里？A东方。B西方。C北方。根据“Confucius (孔子) is travelling to the east.”可知孔子要去东方，故选A。

questions.question:
How many children are arguing? (   )
A．One.
B．Two.
C．Three.
questions.explanation: 句意：有多少个孩子在争辩？A一个。B二个。C三个。根据“He sees two children arguing (争论).”可知有两个小孩在争论，故选B。

questions.question:
When the sun appears at dawn (黎明), it looks like a ______. (   )
A．wheel
B．plate
C．bowl
questions.explanation: 句意：当太阳在黎明出现时，它看起来像一个______。A轮子，B盘子，C碗。根据““When the sun appears (出现),” says the child, “it is as big as a wheel (轮子), but at noon it is only like a plate or a bowl. Isn’t it true that objects (物体) far away seem smaller while those nearby seem bigger?””可知太阳刚刚出现时像一个轮子，故选A。

questions.question:
Things ______ to us is hotter and things farther away is cooler. (   )
A．farther
B．nearer
C．bigger
questions.explanation: 句意：对我们来说______的东西更热，更远地方的东西更凉爽。A更远的，B更近的，C更大的。根据““When the sun appears,” says the other child, “it is cool, but at noon it is as hot as putting your hand in hot water. Isn’t it true that things nearer to us is hotter and things farther away is cooler?””可知离太阳更近的物体更热，更远的物体更凉爽，故选B。

questions.question:
Confucius ______ which of them is right. (   )
A．don’t know
B．know
C．doesn’t know
questions.explanation: 句意：孔子______他们中哪一个是对的。A不知道，B知道，C不知道。根据“Confucius hears these, but he doesn’t know which of them is right.”可知孔子也不知道他们谁正确，主语是Confucius，助动词用does，故选C。

passages.content:
Everyone has a family name. In China, the family name is the first name, but in English-speaking countries, the family name is the last name. Do you know how English people get their family names?

Some family names come from the places of their homes. For example, a man lives on or near a hill, his family name may be Hill. In England, people’s family names may be Wood, Lake, because they live near the wood or the lake.

Some family names come from a person’s job. If a person is a cook, his family name may be Cook.

And many people get their family names from their fathers’ names. If you hear the name “Jackson”, you can know that he is the son of Jack.

questions.question:
The passage(文章) is about ______. (   )
A．first names
B．English families
C．family names
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：这篇文章是关于______。A名字，B英国家庭，C姓氏，通读全文可知这篇文章主要讲述了英国人的姓氏由来，故选C。

questions.question:
In this passage, English people usually have ______ ways to get their family names. (   )
A．one
B．three
C．four
questions.explanation: 句意：在这篇文章中，英国人通常有______方式来获得他们的姓氏。A一种，B三种，C四种，根据原文“Some family names come from the places of their homes. Some family names come from a person’s job. And many people get their family names from their fathers’ names.”可知有些姓氏来自他们家居住的地方。有些姓氏来自一个人的工作。许多人的姓氏都是从父亲的名字中得来的。共三种方式，故选B。

questions.question:
A man lives near the lake. His family name may be ______. (   )
A．Hill
B．Lake
C．Wood
questions.explanation: 句意：一个人住在湖边。他的姓氏可能是______。A山，B湖，C木材。根据原文“In England, people’s family names may be Wood, Lake, because they live near the wood or the lake.”可知在英格兰，人们的姓氏可能是Wood，Lake，因为他们住在树林或湖附近。故选B。

questions.question:
Jack’s family name is Cook. His family name may come from the ______. (   )
A．place
B．job
C．country
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克的姓氏是Cook。他的姓氏可能来自______。A地方，B工作，C国家，根据原文“If a person is a cook, his family name may be Cook.”可知如果一个人是一名厨师，他的姓氏可能是Cook。所以他的姓氏可能来自工作，故选B。

questions.question:
Which of the following is NOT true? (   )
A．Family names are the same between China and England.
B．Everyone has a family name.
C．Hill, Lake, Cook are the last names in England.
questions.explanation: 句意：哪一个不是真的？A中国和英国的姓氏是一样的。B每个人都有一个姓氏。CHill，Lake，Cook在英国都是姓氏。根据原文“In China, the family name is the first name, but in English-speaking countries, the family name is the last name.”可知在中国，姓氏就是名字中的第一个字，但在英国，姓氏就是名字中最后一个字。中国和英国的姓氏是不一样的，故选A。

passages.content:
New Year’s Day is on the first day of January.

On Monday, Mom cooks a lot of yummy food. My family have a big dinner together. We like the food very much.

On Tuesday, my good friends and I play lots of games. We play football and cards together. It is fun. In the evening, Mom and I go to see a film. It is very interesting and exciting. We like it very much.

Mom and I go to the supermarket by bike on Wednesday. We buy a lot of food and some fruit. I eat the food and watch TV when we go back on New Year’s Day. I am very happy and excited.

questions.question:
When is New Year’s Day? (   )
A．On June 1st.
B．On December 31st.
C．On December 25th.
D．On January 1st.
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：元旦是什么时候？A在6月1日。B在12月31日。C在12月25日。D在1月1日。根据“New Year’s Day is on the first day of January.”，可知元旦在1月1日，故选D。

questions.question:
We have a big dinner ______. (   )
A．on Monday
B．on Tuesday
C．on Wednesday
D．on Saturday
questions.explanation: 句意：我们______吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。A在星期一，B在星期二，C在星期三，D在星期六，根据“On Monday, Mom cooks a lot of yummy food. My family have a big dinner together.”，可知在星期一吃一顿丰盛的晚餐，故选A。

questions.question:
On Tuesday evening, I go to see a film with ______. (   )
A．my friends
B．my mother
C．my father
D．my sister
questions.explanation: 句意：在星期二晚上，我和______去看电影。A我的朋友，B我的妈妈，C我的爸爸，D我的姐姐/妹妹，根据“In the evening, Mom and I go to see a film.”，可知和妈妈去看电影，故选B。

questions.question:
We go to the supermarket ______ on Wednesday. (   )
A．by car
B．by bus
C．by bike
D．on foot
questions.explanation: 句意：我们星期三______去超市。A开车，B坐公共汽车，C骑自行车，D步行，根据“Mom and I go to the supermarket by bike on Wednesday.”，可知骑自行车去超市，故选C。

questions.question:
What do we buy in the supermarket? (   )
A．We buy some food and fruit.
B．We buy some chicken.
C．We buy some vegetables.
D．We buy some meat and cakes.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在超市里买什么？A我们买一些食物和水果。B我们买一些鸡肉。C我们买一些蔬菜。D我们买一些肉和蛋糕。根据“We buy a lot of food and some fruit.”，可知买一些食物和水果，故选A。

passages.content:
Mr. White is a fat man. He is not healthy. So he wants to be healthy and thin.

But how to be healthy and thin? The doctor gives him some advice(建议). He needs to lose weight(减重) and keep healthy.

If he wants to lose weight, the first way is to be on a diet(节食). Eating too much is bad for his health and he will easily turn fat! The best way is to eat a little sugar, but more vegetables and fruits! The other way is to do more exercise! Sport is good for his health. He should keep running or walking for about twenty minutes every day. This is the most straight-forward method(最直接的方法).

If keep doing this for a long time, Mr. White will be more healthy.

questions.question:
What is the first way to lose weight? (   )
A．To be on a diet.
B．keep healthy.
C．Eating a little sugar.
questions.explanation: 句意：第一种减肥方法是什么？A节食。B保持健康。C吃一点糖。根据“If he wants to lose weight, the first way is to be on a diet(节食).” 可知第一种减肥方法是节食，故选A。

questions.question:
What is the the best way to lose weight? (   )
A．Eating  much.
B．Eating more vegetables and fruits.
C．Eating much sugar.
questions.explanation: 句意：减肥最好的方法是什么？A吃得多。B多吃蔬菜和水果。C吃太多糖。根据“The best way is to eat a little sugar, but more vegetables and fruits! ” 可知吃一点糖，但是多吃蔬菜和水果，故选B。

questions.question:
What is bad for Mr. White’s health? (   )
A．Eating a little sugar.
B．Eating more vegetables.
C．Eating too much food.
questions.explanation: 句意：什么对怀特先生的健康有害？A吃一点糖。B多吃蔬菜。C吃太多食物。根据“Eating too much is bad for his health and he will easily turn fat! ” 可知吃得太多对他的健康不好，故选C。

questions.question:
What is good for Mr White’s health? (   )
A．Eating too much.
B．Eating more vegetables.
C．Eating much sugar.
questions.explanation: 句意：什么对怀特先生的健康有益？A吃得多。B多吃蔬菜。C吃太多糖。根据“The best way is to eat a little sugar, but more vegetables and fruits! ” 可知吃一点糖，并且多吃蔬菜和水果是最好的方法，也就是对怀特先生的健康有益的，故选B。

questions.question:
What is the most straightforward method to keep healthy? (   )
A．Eating more vegetables.
B．Eating a little sugar.
C．Doing more exercise.
questions.explanation: 句意：保持健康最直接的方法是什么？A多吃蔬菜。B吃一点糖。C多做运动。根据“Sport is good for his health. He should keep running or walking for about twenty minutes every day. This is the most straight-forward method(最直接的方法).” 可知多做运动是保持健康最直接的方法，故选C。

passages.content: Hi, I’m Peter. I was busy last weekend. On Saturday, I did my homework in the morning. After breakfast, I cleaned my room and washed my clothes. In the afternoon, I played badminton with my friend. In the evening, I read books. On Sunday, I visited my grandparents with my mother in the morning. In the afternoon, I went shopping with my friends. And I watched TV at night. How busy I was!

questions.question:
On Saturday morning, Peter ______. (   )
A．did his homework
B．washed his clothes
C．read books
questions.explanation: 句意：在星期六上午，彼得_______。A做作业，B洗衣服，C看书，根据“On Saturday, I did my homework in the morning.”，可知彼得星期六上午做作业，故选A。

questions.question:
Did Peter clean his room on Saturday? (   )
A．Yes, he is.
B．Yes, he did.
C．No, he didn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得星期六打扫房间了吗？根据“After breakfast, I cleaned my room and washed my clothes.”，可知彼得星期六打扫房间了，答语为肯定回答，did提问用did回答，故选B。

questions.question:
Peter ______ with his friend on Saturday afternoon. (   )
A．played football
B．played basketball
C．played badminton
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得星期六下午和朋友______。A踢足球，B打篮球，C打羽毛球，根据“In the afternoon, I played badminton with my friend.”，可知彼得星期六下午和朋友打羽毛球了，故选C。

questions.question:
On Sunday morning, Peter visited his grandparents with his ______. (   )
A．mother
B．father
C．friend
questions.explanation: 句意：在星期天上午，彼得和他的______看望祖父母。A妈妈，B爸爸，C朋友，根据“On Sunday, I visited my grandparents with my mother in the morning.”，可知在星期天上午，彼得和妈妈看望祖父母，故选A。

questions.question:
Peter ______ on Sunday evening. (   )
A．went shopping
B．watched TV
C．read books
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得在星期天晚上_______。A去购物，B看电视，C看书，根据“And I watched TV at night.”，可知彼得在星期天晚上看电视，故选B。

passages.content: It was sunny on Children’s Day. Jack sat in front of the window, watching the people on the street. He saw many people with their kids. Parents talked and laughed cheerfully. Children also played happily. But Jack was sad and lonely. No one spent the holiday with him. His parents lost their lives in the earthquake(地震) last year. Jack was so sad that he wanted to cry. Just at that time, the door opened and his neighbour, a 5-year-old girl named Dora, came in. She ran to him a box in her hand and said, “Happy Children’s Day! Mum said every child should have a present. ______”

questions.question:
How was the weather that day? (   )
A．Cloudy.
B．Windy.
C．Fine.
questions.explanation: 句意：那天天气怎么样？A多云的。B刮风的。C晴朗的。根据“It was sunny on Children’s Day.”可知儿童节那天天气晴朗。故选C。

questions.question:
What did many people do in the story? (   )
A．They are on the street.
B．They talked and laughed happily.
C．They sat in front of the window.
questions.explanation: 句意：故事里很多人做了什么？A他们在街上。B他们谈笑风生。C他们坐在窗户前面。根据“Parents talked and laughed cheerfully.”可知他们谈笑风生，故选B。

questions.question:
Why did Jack feel sad and lonely? (   )
A．Because he didn’t have any presents.
B．Because he lost his parents.
C．Because he wanted to cry.
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么杰克感到悲伤和孤独？A因为他没有任何礼物。B因为他失去了父母。C因为他想哭。根据“His parents lost their lives in the earthquake(地震) last year.”可知他的父母在地震中丧生，失去了父母，故选B。

questions.question:
Why did Dora come to Jack’s house? (   )
A．Because she wanted to give Jack a present.
B．Because she wanted to get a present.
C．Because she wanted to play with Jack.
questions.explanation: 句意：多拉为什么去杰克家？A因为她想给杰克一份礼物。B因为她想得到一份礼物。C因为她想和杰克一起玩。根据“She ran to him a box in her hand and said, “Happy Children’s Day! Mum said every child should have a present.””可知多拉想给杰克一份礼物，故选A。

questions.question:
文中“______”上的句子应该是______ (   )
A．Let’s go outside to play.
B．Let’s be friends.
C．This is for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：文中“______”上的句子应该是_______。A让我们去外面玩吧。B让我们成为朋友吧。C这是给你的。根据“She ran to him a box in her hand and said, “Happy Children’s Day! Mum said every child should have a present.”可知多拉想给杰克一份礼物，应该说这是给你的礼物，故选C。

passages.content:
Mr Reece was a farmer. He and his wife(妻子) grew a lot of things. They worked very hard. One day, Mr Reece said to his wife, “Let’s go to the city next Sunday. We can have a good lunch there, and then we’ll go to the cinema.” His wife was very happy when she heard this, because she and her husband(丈夫) always ate a lot. She didn’t like cooking three times a day.

They went to the city by train the next Sunday. When they got to the city, they walked about for an hour. When it was twelve o’clock, they wanted to have a meal. They looked at some restaurants. Out of one of them was a notice(通告), “Lunch 12:30 to 2:30, 1.5 dollars.”

“Well, that’s good,” said Mr Reece, “we can eat for two hours for 1.5 dollars here. That’s too cheap. This is the place for us.”

questions.question:
Mr Reece usually worked in ______. (   )
A．the fields
B．the city
C．the restaurant
questions.explanation: 句意：里斯先生通常在________工作。A地里，B城市，C饭店，根据文章“Mr Reece was a farmer. ”得知里斯先生是一名农民，在地里工作，故选A。

questions.question:
Mr Reece and his wife went to the city ______. (   )
A．to have a good lunch
B．to see a film
C．A and B
questions.explanation: 句意：里斯先生和他的妻子去城市_________。A吃丰盛的午餐，B看电影，C吃丰盛的午餐和去看电影，根据文章“ One day, Mr Reece said to his wife, “Let’s go to the city next Sunday. We can have a good lunch there, and then we’ll go to the cinema.” ”得知有一天，里斯先生对妻子说：“下周日我们去城里吧。我们可以在那里吃顿丰盛的午餐，然后去看电影。”故选C。

questions.question:
When did Mr and Mrs Reece arrive in the city? (   )
A．At about 11:00.
B．At about 12:00.
C．At about 12:30.
questions.explanation: 句意：里斯和里斯夫人什么时候到的城市？A在大约11点。B在大约12点。C在大约12点半。根据文章“When they got to the city, they walked about for an hour. When it was twelve o’clock, they wanted to have a meal. ”得知当他们到达城市时，他们四处走了一个小时。十二点钟的时候，他们想吃顿饭。得知十一点钟到的城市，故选A。

questions.question:
We can see that Mr Reece ______. (   )
A．was poor
B．understood the notice
C．didn’t understand the notice
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以明白里斯先生________。A是穷的，B理解了通告的意思，C没能理解明白通告的意思，根据文章“They looked at some restaurants. Out of one of them was a notice(通告), “Lunch 12:30 to 2:30, 1.5 dollars.””得知牌子的意思是：每顿饭 1.50 ，可以在 12:30 至 2:30 之间的任何时间来就餐。所以说他们没能理解明白通告的意思，故选C。

questions.question:
—Why did Mr Reece say that restaurant was the place for them? (   )
—Because ______.
A．12:30 to 2:30 was the best time for lunch
B．he thought they could eat a lot and it was cheap
C．they were very tired and hungry
questions.explanation: 句意：—为什么里斯先生说那家餐厅是他们的地方？—因为________。A12:30到2:30是吃午饭的最佳时间，B他认为他们可以吃很多而且很便宜，C他们又累又饿。根据文章““Well, that’s good,” said Mr Reece, “we can eat for two hours for 1.5 dollars here. That’s too cheap. This is the place for us.””得知“好吧，那太好了，”Reece先生说，“我们在这里花1.5美元可以吃两个小时。太便宜了。这是适合我们的地方。”故选B。

passages.content:
Of all the teachers, we love our English teacher best. She is twenty-eight years old. We all call her Miss. Li. She is not tall, but a little thin. In her class we feel very happy. She always makes her English lessons interesting. Sometimes she lets us watch the video. Sometimes, she teaches us English songs. She often shows us how to learn English well. She asks us to do more listening, speaking, reading and writing. After class we often talk with her in English. She is always happy to help us.

One day, one of my classmates, Mike had a bad cold and got a fever. Miss. Li took him to see a doctor, and got some medicine for him. When Mike stayed at home, Miss. Li went to help him with his lessons. What a kind teacher!

questions.question:
Miss. Li is ________. (   )
A．tall
B．a little thin
C．old
questions.explanation: 句意：李老师______。A高的，B有点瘦，C老的，根据“She is not tall, but a little thin.”可知她有点瘦。故选B。

questions.question:
We feel very happy in Miss. Li’s class because ________. (   )
A．English is difficult
B．she is strict
C．her lessons are interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在李老师的课上非常开心，因为______。A英语很难，B她很严厉，C她的课很有趣，根据“ In her class we feel very happy. She always makes her English lessons interesting.”可知她的课很有意思。故选C。

questions.question:
Miss. Li is ________. (   )
A．a science teacher
B．a music teacher
C．an English teacher
questions.explanation: 句意：李老师是______。A一名科学老师，B一名音乐老师，C一名英语老师，根据“She always makes her English lessons interesting.”可知是英语老师。故选C。

questions.question:
Mike ________ and got a fever one day. (   )
A．had a bad cold
B．had a book
C．had a lesson
questions.explanation: 句意：一天迈克______，发烧了。A重感冒，B有一本书，C上一节课，根据“One day, one of my classmates, Mike had a bad cold and got a fever.”可知是感冒了。故选A。

questions.question:
Why do they love the English teacher? (   )
A．Because she is tall and thin.
B．Because she is a kind teacher.
C．Because she is from England.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们为什么喜欢英语老师？A因为她又高又瘦。B因为她是一个和蔼的老师。C因为她来自英国。根据短文最后一段可知因为她是一个和蔼的老师。故选B。

passages.content:
In your life, there are a lot of people around you. They are your relatives, neighbors, friends or classmates. Sometimes you get along well with them, but sometimes don’t. What can you do when someone hurts you? Most people may be angry or even fight with him. But it’s not a good idea. You’d better forget all this and forgive him.

Maybe it’s not easy for you to do that, but it’s possible. Please remember. Keep a good mood, and you will keep healthy. Staying angry with others, in fact, means letting others’ mistakes treat yourself unfairly. How can you forgive others?

First, think of something pleasant and try to get yourself happy. Second, don’t wait others to say sorry to you. If anyone hurts you, he won’t say sorry to you. He may just want to hurt you or just don’t see things the same way. Third, try to see things in others’ shoes. You can understand their minds better and make yourself a little happier.

At last try to know yourself very well. Whose mistakes caused that, yours or others’? If it’s your fault, try to say sorry to them. If it isn’t, smile at the thing.

questions.question:
This passage tells us ________. (    )
A．to get along well with others
B．to say sorry to others bravely when we hurt them
C．to forgive others when they hurt you
D．to wait others to say sorry to you
questions.explanation: 句意：这篇文章告诉我们________。A与人和睦相处，B当我们伤害别人的时候勇敢地对别人说对不起，C当别人伤害你的时候原谅别人，D等待别人对你说对不起，根据“You’d better forget all this and forgive him. ”你最好忘记并原谅他。故选C。

questions.question:
Forgiving others is ______ according to the writer’s opinion. (    )
A．possible
B．silly
C．easy
D．unbelievable
questions.explanation: 句意：根据作者的观点，原谅别人是______。A可能的，B愚蠢的，C容易的，D不可置信的，根据“Maybe it’s not easy for you to do that, but it’s possible.”可知是可能的。故选A。

questions.question:
The underlined sentence means “_______” in Chinese. (    )
A．尽力坚持自己的观点
B．尽力让别人接受自己的观点
C．尽量站在别人的立场上看问题
D．尽量传递自己的观点
questions.explanation: 句意：划线句子的中文意思是______。try to努力去做，see things看事情，in others’ shoes站在别人的角度，故选C。

questions.question:
Forgetting others’ mistakes and staying happy can make us _______. (    )
A．glad
B．disappointed
C．perfect
D．healthy
questions.explanation: 句意：忘记别人的错误，保持快乐可以使我们_______。A高兴的，B失望的，C完美的，D健康的，根据“Keep a good mood, and you will keep healthy.”可知使我们健康。故选D。

passages.content:
I’m Amy. I went to Beijing with my parents last holiday.

Day 1 We went to Beijing by plane. I was excited

Day 2 We went to the Great Wall by bus. I bought some presents for my friends.

Day 3 My mom went shopping, my father and I went to the Wild Animal Park. We saw lots of animals there: tigers, lions, bears, cheetahs.

Day 4 We went to the Ocean Park and watched dolphin show there, they were interesting.

Day 5 We ate delicious food in Wangfujing Snack Street in the morning. In the afternoon, we went back home by plane.
What a happy day!
Wild Animal Park野生动物园
Ocean Park海洋公园
Wangfujing Snack Street王府井小吃街

questions.question:
Where did Amy go last holiday? (    )
A．The book store.
B．The park.
C．Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米上个假期去了哪里？A书店。B公园。C北京。根据“I’m Amy. I went to Beijing with my parents last holiday.”，可知艾米上个假期去了北京，故选C。

questions.question:
How did Amy go to the Great Wall? (    )
A．By car.
B．By bus.
C．On foot.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米怎么去的长城？A坐汽车。B乘公共汽车。C步行。根据“We went to the Great Wall by bus.”，可知艾米乘公共汽车去的长城，故选B。

questions.question:
Amy went to the Wild Animal Park with ______. (    )
A．her father
B．her mother
C．her parents
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米和______去的野生动物园。A她的爸爸，B她的妈妈，C她的父母，根据“My mom went shopping, my father and I went to the Wild Animal Park.”，可知艾米和她的爸爸去的野生动物园，故选A。

questions.question:
—When did Amy go to the Ocean Park? (    )
—She went to the Ocean Park on ______.
A．Day 2
B．Day 3
C．Day4
questions.explanation: 句意：—艾米什么时候去的海洋公园？—她在_______去的海洋公园。根据“Day 4 We went to the Ocean Park and watched dolphin show there, they were interesting.”，可知艾米第4天去的海洋公园，故选C。

questions.question:
—What did Amy do in Wangfujing Snack Street? (    )
—She ______.
A．ate delicious food
B．bought some presents
C．watched dolphin show
questions.explanation: 句意：—艾米在王府井小吃街做了什么？—她______。A吃了美味的食物，B买了一些礼物，C观看海豚表演，根据“We ate delicious food in Wangfujing Snack Street in the morning.”，可知艾米在王府井小吃街吃了美味的食物，故选A。

passages.content:
The following discussion took place between a father and his nine-year-old son.
“It’s unfair, Dad. Mum wants me to make my bed, but I don’t know how.”
“It’s time for you to learn. Where are your clean sheets?”
“I don’t know.”
“What so you mean you don’t know? You need to take care of your things.”
“Where are Jack’s sheets?” the father called to his wife.
“Right next to ours.” the wife answered. 
After a moment, the father asked slowly “Where are ours?”

questions.question:
The discussion takes place between ______. (   )
A．a husband and a wife
B．a mother and her son
C．a father and his son
D．a mother and a father
questions.explanation: 句意：这次讨论发生在_________之间。A丈夫和妻子之间，B母亲和儿子之间，C父亲和儿子之间，D母亲和父亲之间，根据原文The following discussion took place between a father and his nine-year-old son.可知这次讨论发生在一个父亲和他九岁的儿子之间，故选C。

questions.question:
The son doesn’t know ______. (   )
A．how to wash his sheets
B．how to make his bed
C．how to clean his sheets
D．how to clean his bed
questions.explanation: 句意：儿子不知道_________。A怎么洗他的床单，B怎么整理他的床，C怎么清洁他的床单，D怎么清洁他的床，根据原文Mum wants me to make my bed, but I don’t know how.可知这个儿子不知道怎么整理他的床，故选B。

questions.question:
The father doesn’t know ______. (   )
A．how to wash sheets
B．how to make his bed
C．how to clean sheets
D．where his sheets are
questions.explanation: 句意：父亲不知道_________。A怎么洗床单，B怎么整理他的床，C怎么清洁床单，D他的床单在哪里，根据原文Where are Jack’s sheets?” the father called to his wife.After a moment, the father asked slowly “Where are ours?”可知这位父亲不仅不知道杰克的床单在哪里，也不知道他的床单在哪里，故选D。

questions.question:
The father says his son is ______ because he doesn’t know where his ______ is. (   )
A．careful, sheet
B．careless, bed
C．careful, bed
D．careless, sheet
questions.explanation: 句意：父亲说他的儿子是_________因为他不知道他的_________在哪里。第一空：careful仔细的；careless粗心的，根据原文“It’s time for you to learn. Where are your clean sheets?”“I don’t know.”可知儿子不知道它的干净的床单在哪里，是粗心的；第二空：bed床；sheet床单，根据原文“It’s time for you to learn. Where are your clean sheets?”“I don’t know.”可知他不知道床单在哪里，故选D。

questions.question:
Who do you think take care of the housework (家务) in the family? (   )
A．The father.
B．The mother.
C．The child.
D．No one.
questions.explanation: 句意：你认为谁来料理家里的家务？A父亲，B母亲，C孩子，D没有人，根据原文“Where are Jack’s sheets?” the father called to his wife.可致父亲打电话问母亲床单在哪里，可见是母亲在料理家务，故选B。

passages.content: One day, a father drives a car home with his little son, Tom. He is only seven years old. At this age, he is interested in all kinds of things and he likes asking questions every day. The boy asks his father, “What is drunk (喝醉的),  Dad?” “Well, my son,” his father says. “Look! Two policemen are standing over there. If I see four policemen now, I am drunk.” “But, Dad", the boy says, “now there’s only ONE policeman!” Then the policeman stops the car and gives the father a fine (罚单).

questions.question:
—How do they go home? —They go home _______. (  )
A．in a car
B．on a bus
C．on foot
questions.explanation: 句意：—他们怎样回家？—他们____回家。A开车，B乘坐公交车，C步行，根据文中One day, a father drives a car home with his little son, Tom. 得知他们两个开车回家，故选A。

questions.question:
—How old is the boy? —He is _______. (  )
A．12
B．9
C．7
questions.explanation: 句意：—男孩多大年龄？—他_____。A12岁，B9岁，C7岁，根据文中He is only seven years old.得知小男孩七岁大。故选C。

questions.question:
The boy thinks everything is interesting and he _______every day. (  )
A．likes driving a car
B．likes asking questions
C．likes drinking water
questions.explanation: 句意：小男孩认为任何事都有趣并且他每天都会_____。根据文中At this age, he is interested in all kinds of things and he likes asking questions every day.得知他每天都喜欢问问题。故选B。

questions.question:
_______ gives the father a fine. (  )
A．The policeman
B．Tom
C．Tom’s father
questions.explanation: 句意：_____给了爸爸一张罚单。根据文中Then the policeman stops the car and gives the father a fine (罚单).得知警察给爸爸开了张罚单。故选A。

questions.question:
—How many policemen are there in the story? —In fact (事实上), there is / are_______. (  )
A．one
B．two
C．four
questions.explanation: 句意：—在故事中有几个警察？—事实上，就有_____个警察。根据文中 If I see four policemen now, I am drunk.” “But, Dad", the boy says, “now there’s only ONE policeman!”得知事实上就有一个警察。故选A。

passages.content:
Jim: Let's play soccer.
Allan: No, I don't have a soccer ball.

Jim: Do you have a basketball?

questions.question:
Does Allan have a soccer ball? (   )
A．Yes, he does
B．No, he doesn't

D．No, they don't
questions.explanation: 【分析】句意：Allan有一个足球吗？根据对话Jim: Let's play soccer.Allan: No, I don't have a soccer ball.得知Allan没有足球。故选B。

questions.question:
-Does Allan have a volleyball? (   )
A．Yes, he does
B．No, he doesn't
C．We don't know
D．We doesn't know
questions.explanation: 句意：Allan有一个排球吗？根据对话内容，对话中没有提到，所以我们不知道Allan有咩有排球，故选C。

questions.question:
Does Allan have a basketball? (   )
A．Yes, he does
B．No, I don't
C．No, he doesn't
D．Yes, I do
questions.explanation: 句意：Allan有一个篮球吗？根据对话Jim: Do you have a basketball?Allan: No, I don't. 得知Allan没有篮球。故选C。

questions.question:
___________ has a basketball. (   )
A．Jim
B．Allan
C．My brother
D．Allan's brother
questions.explanation: 句意：_____有一个篮球。根据对话Jim: Do you have a basketball?Allan: No, I don't. But my brother has one.得知Allan的兄弟有一个篮球。故选D。

questions.question:
Jim and Allan will go to play ___________.(   )
A．Soccer
B．volleyball
C．basketball
D．the basketball
questions.explanation: 句意：Jim和Allan将要去_____。根据对话Jim: Do you have a basketball?Allan: No, I don't. But my brother has one.Jim: That sounds good. Let's go.Allan: Great.得知他们要去打篮球。A.足球，B.排球，C.篮球，D.错误选项，故选C。

passages.content:
It was Saturday. Chen Jie and her mother exchanged roles(交换角色). She did her mother's work and her mother did Chen Jie's work instead.

Chen Jie got up at six o'clock in the morning. She cooked breakfast. Her mother read books and did homework in the study. Chen Jie wanted to watch TV, but the house was in a mess(不整洁). She cleaned every room in the house. Then she washed clothes. At last, she sat on the sofa. She was very tired. She said to her mother, “Mum, I'm so tired. It's not easy to be a hard-working mum.” Her mother said, “It's also not easy to be a hard-working student.” They understood (理解) each other more than before.

questions.question:
Chen Jie exchanged roles with her ______. (   )
A．father
B．brother
C．mother
questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：陈杰和她的____交换了角色。根据Chen Jie and her mother exchanged roles(交换角色).可知是和妈妈交换了角色。故选C。

questions.question:
Chen Jie wanted to ______ after she cooked breakfast. (   )
A．watch TV
B．clean the house
C．sit on the sofa
questions.explanation: 句意：陈杰做完早饭后想____。根据She cooked breakfast. …Chen Jie wanted to watch TV, but the house was in a mess(不整洁).可知陈杰想看电视。故选A。

questions.question:
Her mother read books and ______. (   )
A．cooked breakfast
B．did homework
C．watched TV
questions.explanation: 句意：她的妈妈读书和____。根据Her mother read books and did homework in the study.可知她的妈妈读书和写作业。故选B。

questions.question:
At last, Chen Jie was very ______. (   )
A．happy
B．sad
C．tired
questions.explanation: 句意：最后，陈杰很____。根据At last, she sat on the sofa. She was very tired. 可知她很累。故选C。

questions.question:
According to the passage (根据短文), Chen Jie ______ on Saturday. (   )
A．cooked breakfast, cleaned every room and washed clothes
B．cooked breakfast, read books and watched TV
C．did homework. read books and watched TV
questions.explanation: 句意：根据短文，陈杰周六____。根据短文可知她做了早饭，打扫了每个房间，洗了衣服。故选A。

passages.content: Every year people celebrate the Spring Festival in China. Usually it is in January or February. It is the most important festival in China. So before it comes, everyone buys many things, and they often make a special kind of food called dumpling. It means “Come together”. Parents always buy new clothes for their children and children also buy presents for their parents. On the Spring Festival Eve（除夕）, all the family members come back home. They sing, dance and play cards. When they enjoy the meal, they give each other the best wishes（祝愿）for the coming year. They all have a good time.

questions.question:
Which is the most important festival in China? (   )
A．The Mid-autumn Day.
B．Chinese New Year.
C．Children’s Day.
D．May Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国最重要的节日是哪一个？A. The Mid-autumn Day.中秋节；B. Chinese New Year. 中国的新年；C. Children’s Day.儿童节；D. May Day.五一节；根据Every year people celebrate the Spring Festival in China. Usually it is in January or February. It is the most important festival in China. 可知是春节，即中国的新年，故选B。

questions.question:
The Chinese usually have their Spring Festival in ____________. (   )
A．January or February
B．February or March
C．September or October
D．December or January
questions.explanation: 句意：中国人通常在_____过春节。A. January or February一月或二月； B. February or March二月或三月； C. September or October九月或十月；D. December or January十二月或一月；根据Usually it is in January or February. 可知是在一月或二月，故选A。

questions.question:
What’s the special kind of food for the Spring Festival in China? (   )
A．Fruit.
B．Fish.
C．Chicken.
D．Dumpling.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国人们在春节的时候吃什么特别的食物？A. Fruit.水果；B. Fish.鱼；C. Chicken. 鸡肉；D. Dumpling.饺子；根据So before it comes, everyone buys many things, and they often make a special kind of food called dumpling. 可知是饺子，故选D。

questions.question:
The special kind of food for the Spring Festival means “____________”. (   )
A．be nice
B．be hungry
C．come together
D．come back
questions.explanation: 句意：春节这种特殊的食物意思是____。A. be nice很好； B. be hungry很饿； C. come together到一起；D. come back回来。根据It means “Come together”. 可知，故选C。

questions.question:
When Chinese people are having dinner on the Spring Festival Eve, they ____________. (   )
A．sing, dance and play cards
B．buy each other presents
C．always drink too much
D．give their wishes to others
questions.explanation: 句意：当人们在春节前夕吃晚饭的时候，他们______。A. sing, dance and play cards唱歌，跳舞和玩扑克。 B. buy each other presents互相买礼物；C. always drink too much总是喝太多酒；D. give their wishes to others给别人他们的祝愿。根据 When they enjoy the meal, they give each other the best wishes（祝愿）for the coming year. 可知，故选D。

passages.content:
Last summer, I went to Shenzhen for my holiday. It is a city of the seashore. I enjoyed having a walk along the beach after supper and having a swim in the afternoon. The sky there was blue. Wherever I went, I could always see the green trees and the colorful flowers. They were really beautiful.

This year, I am planning to spend my summer holiday on sports. Playing basketball is always my favourite. So some of my classmates and I want to make a small team and play basketball together. If so, we may have a match against other teams. I really like playing basketball.

questions.question:
Shenzhen is a ________ of the seashore. (　)
A．town
B．city
C．country
questions.explanation: 根据文中It is a city of the seashore.它是一个海滨城市。可知深圳是一个海滨城市。A. town乡镇，B. city城市，C. country国家。B符合题意，故选B。

questions.question:
What did you enjoy in Shenzhen? (　)
A．Having a walk.
B．Having a swim.
C．Having a walk and swim.
questions.explanation: 该句问句的含义为你在深圳喜欢什么？根据文中I enjoyed having a walk along the beach after supper and having a swim in the afternoon.我喜欢晚饭后在海滩上散步和下午的时候去游泳。可知是喜欢散步和游泳。A. Having a walk.散步，B. Having a swim.游泳，C. Having a walk and swim. 散步和游泳。C符合题意，故选C。

questions.question:
This year, what are you going to do in the summer holiday? (　)
A．Go to Shenzhen.
B．Have a trip.
C．Do sports.
questions.explanation: 该句的含义为今年的暑假你打算去做什么？根据文中This year, I am planning to spend my summer holiday on sports.今年，我打算把我的暑假花在运动上面。A. Go to Shenzhen.去深圳，B. Have a trip.去旅行，C. Do sports.做运动。可知C符合题意，故选C。

questions.question:
What is your favourite sport? (　)
A．Playing basketball.
B．Having a walk.
C．Making a small team.
questions.explanation: 该问句的含义为你最喜欢的运动是什么？根据文中Playing basketball is always my favourite. 打篮球一直是我最喜欢的。A. Playing basketball.打篮球，B. Having a walk.散步，C. Making a small team. 组一个小团队，可知A符合题意，故选A。

questions.question:
What do you want to do this summer? (　)
A．See the green trees and the colourful flowers.
B．Make a small team and have a match against other teams.
C．Play basketball at the gym.
questions.explanation: 该问句的含义为这个夏天你想要的做什么？根据文中I want to make a small team and play basketball together. 我想要组一个小团队和一起打篮球。A. See the green trees and the colourful flowers. 看绿色的树和五颜六色的花。B. Make a small team and have a match against other teams. 组一个小团队和其他队打比赛。C. Play basketball at the gym.在体育馆打篮球。可知B符合题意，故选B。

passages.content:
The Road family often does housework together at the weekends. Pam often cleans bedrooms. Her father buys groceries (食品杂货)  for the next week. Her mum washes the clothes. John, Pam's brother, helps to cut grass in their garden.

The Roads often ride a bike to the park nearby. In the park, they can play basketball and football. They always have a good time there. It is happy when a family works and plays together.

questions.question:
How many people are there in the Road family? (   )
A．Two.
B．Three.
C．Four.
D．Five.
questions.explanation: 句意：罗德家有多少人？A二。B三。C四。D五。根据短文中的 Pam，Her father，Her mum，John, Pam's brother, 可知共四口人，故选C。

questions.question:
The Road family likes to ______. (   )
A．go on a picnic
B．go shopping
C．have a rest
D．go to the park
questions.explanation: 句意：罗德家喜欢_____。A去野餐；B去购物；C休息；D去公园；根据短文中的The Roads often ride a bike to the park nearby.可知罗德一家人喜欢去公园，故选D。

questions.question:
When the family work together, they feel ______. (   )
A．tired
B．happy
C．angry
D．sad
questions.explanation: 句意：当家人一起工作时，他们感觉____。A累的；B高兴的；C生气的；D难过的；根据短文中的It is happy when a family works and plays together.可知他们感觉高兴的，故选B。

questions.question:
______ cuts the grass in the garden. (   )
A．Father
B．Mother
C．Pam
D．John
questions.explanation: 句意：____在花园里割草。A爸爸；B妈妈；C帕姆；D约翰；根据短文中的John, Pam's brother, helps to cut grass in their garden.可知约翰在公园里割草，故选D。

questions.question:
A good title (标题) for the passage is ______. (   )
A．A family works and plays together
B．Cleaning the rooms
C．A happy family
D．Pam and her parents
questions.explanation: 句意：这篇文章的一个好题目是____。A一个家庭在一起工作和玩耍；B打扫房间；C一个幸福的家庭；D帕姆和她的父母；根据短文大意，可知他们有一个幸福的家庭，故选C。

passages.content:
I was born in a small river. When I was young, the river was my home. I did not know my father or mother, but I had many, many brothers and sisters. I swam and played with them.

At that time I did not look like my father or mother. I had no legs, but I had a tail. I looked like a fish. Then my tail became shorter and shorter. And now I have four legs and a very short tail.

I know I’m going to have no tail at all. I’m going to be like my father and mother. Then I’m going to jump out of the water. I’m going to live on the land （陆地） and in the water, too. I’m going to eat a lot of insects （昆虫）--- a lot of bad insects.

questions.question:
When I was young, the ____ was my home. (  )
A．land
B．river
C．water
questions.explanation: 【解析】题干句意：当我年轻的时候，_____是我的家。根据When I was young, the river was my home.可知是河流，A陆地；B河流；C水；故选B。

questions.question:
I had no ______, but I had a _____ when I was young. (  )
A．tail; leg
B．legs; mouth
C．legs; tail
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我没有_____，但我年轻的时候有一_____。根据I had no legs, but I had a tail.可知没有腿但是有一条尾巴，A尾巴，腿；B腿，嘴；C腿，尾巴；故选C。

questions.question:
I looked like a _____. (  )
A．fish
B．frog
C．insect
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我看起来像_____。根据I looked like a fish.可知像鱼，A鱼；B青蛙；C昆虫；故选A。

questions.question:
I’m going to live on the ______ and in the water, too. (  )
A．river
B．earth
C．land
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我也要住在水里和_____。根据I’m going to live on the land （陆地） and in the water, too.可知是水里和陆地，A河流；B地球；C陆地；故选C。

questions.question:
What am I? (  )
A．An insect.
B．A frog.
C．A fish.
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我是什么？根据文章描述可知是青蛙，A昆虫；B一只青蛙；C一条鱼；故选B。

passages.content: I had a good time last weekend. My parents and I went camping in the mountain. Early in the morning, we rode bikes to the mountain. There were many trees and flowers. We bought some food and water in a shop and started to climb the mountain. It was very hard! My mother and I were tired when we went to the top（山顶）. But my father was OK because he was strong. We took pictures, listened to the birds singing and had our lunch there. After that, we played chess in the camp under a big tree. Then we slept in the camp. When we got home, it was late. We had supper at 9:00.

questions.question:
We _______ to the mountain. (   )
A．rode bikes
B．took a bus
C．walked
questions.explanation: 【解析】参考第一行最后一句“we rode bikes to the mountain.”故选A。

questions.question:
We bought food and water _______. (   )
A．in a shop near our home
B．in the afternoon
C．in a shop near the mountain
questions.explanation: 参考“There were many trees and flowers. We bought some food and water in a shop and started to climb the mountain.”前面提到了there，是指在山下；后面又提到开始爬山，所以应该是在山下的小店里买的。故选C。

questions.question:
通过上下可以猜测，划线单词“hard”的意思是_______。(   )
A．容易的
B．艰难的
C．坚硬的
questions.explanation: 前面的it是指前文提到的“climb the mountain”，而后面一句“My mother and I were tired when we went to the top（山顶）”可以看出爬山还是比较累的，故选B。

questions.question:
_________ were tired after climbing the mountain. (   )
A．My mother and I
B．My father and I
C．My parents and I
questions.explanation: 上一题已经提到“My mother and I were tired when we went to the top（山顶）”，故选A。

questions.question:
下面叙述错误的是_______ (   )
A．We took pictures and listened to the birds singing on the top of the mountain.
B．We played chess and slept in the camp.
C．We had supper in the mountain.
questions.explanation: 倒数第二行提到“We took pictures, listened to the birds singing and had our lunch there.”所以在山上吃的是午餐而不是晚饭，所以C是错误的，故选C。

passages.content: Hello, I'm Lily. I will go to a farm with my friends and stay there for three days. We will go there by bus on the morning of October 4th. We will go for a walk on the farm, then we will cook in the farm's kitchen. On the 5th we will go boating on the river. On the 6th we will go horse-riding in the morning. In the afternoon we will buy some eggs. I'm sure we'll be happy on the farm.

questions.question:
Lily will_________ for three days.    (   )
A．stay in a zoo
B．stay in a park
C．stay on a farm
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily will___ for three days。根据"I will go to a farm with my friends and stay there for three days."可知stay on a farm，故选C。

questions.question:
Lily will go to the farm on _________.        (   )
A．October 4th
B．October 5th
C．October 6th
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily will go to the farm on ___。根据"We will go there by bus on the morning of October 4th."可知October 4th，故选A。

questions.question:
Lily will _________ on the 5th.    (   )
A．cook
B．go boating
C．go for a walk
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily will ___ on the 5th。根据"On the 5th we will go boating on the river."可知go boating，故选B。

questions.question:
Lily will go horse-riding on the _________ day.    (   )
A．first
B．second
C．third
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily will go horse-riding on the ___ day。根据"On the 6th we will go horse-riding in the morning."可知third，故选C。

questions.question:
Lily will buy _________ on the farm.      (   )
A．some sheep
B．some ducks
C．some eggs
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily will buy ___ on the farm。根据"In the afternoon we will buy some eggs."可知some eggs，故选C。

passages.content: Mrs Black lived in a city of England. Her husband died two years ago and one of her children worked in the capital and the other three lived in another town. Her husband didn't leave her much money and she had to live a simple life. Sometimes her children went to see her during their holidays，but they stayed with her for only two or three days. Luckily she had a cat with her. She liked it very much and took it everywhere she went.    One winter morning the old woman got up early. She was going to buy some food in a shop. And when she came out, she found there was much snow in the street. She had to sweep it away. And suddenly she found the cat at the corner of the house. And then she laughed .Her cat caught a big mouse.

questions.question:
One of the old woman's children worked in ________.
A．Moscow
B．Paris
C．London
D．New York
questions.explanation: 句意：One of the old woman's children worked in ___。根据"Her husband died two years ago and one of her children worked in the capital and the other three lived in another town."可知London，故选C。

questions.question:
Mrs Black lived a simple life because ________.
A．she wasn't rich enough
B．she hoped to save money for her children
C．she had four children
D．her children hated her
questions.explanation: 句意：Mrs Black lived a simple life because ___。根据"Mrs Black lived in a city of England."可知she wasn't rich enough，故选A。

questions.question:
Her children went to see her ________.
A．Every day
B．during Mrs Black's during
C．when they had holidays
D．When she felt excited
questions.explanation: 句意：Her children went to see her ___。根据"Sometimes her children went to see her during their holidays，but they stayed with her for only two or three days."可知选C。

questions.question:
One winter morning the old woman got up early. She wanted .
A．to make a snow man
B．to sweep the snow
C．to go shopping
D．to find her cat
questions.explanation: 句意：One winter morning the old woman got up early. She wanted。根据"One winter morning the old woman got up early."可知选C。

questions.question:
Mrs Black laughed because ________.
A．she saw her cat
B．A big mouse was caught by her cat
C．her cat was at the corner of the house
D．she thought she could catch a big mouse
questions.explanation: 句意：Mrs Black laughed because ___。根据"And then she laughed .Her cat caught a big mouse."可知A big mouse was caught by her cat，故选B。

passages.content: There are many festivals in a year(年). New Year is in January. Spring Festival is in February this year. People like having a big family dinner with lots of great food. In March, there are Women's Day and Tree Planting Day. May Day and Mother's Day are in May. Children's Day and Father's Day are in June. In September there is Teachers' Day. It's on September 10th. National Day is on October 1st. Christmas is on December 25th.

questions.question:
New Year is in _______.  (   )
A．January
B．February
C．March
questions.explanation: 【解析】根据New Year is in January.可知元旦在一月份。故选A。

questions.question:
People like _______ in Spring Festival.  (   )
A．having a small family dinner
B．having a big family dinner
C．having a big lunch
questions.explanation: 根据People like having a big family dinner with lots of great food.可知在春节人们喜欢吃丰盛的家庭晚餐。故选B。

questions.question:
In March, there are _______ and Tree Planting Day.  (   )
A．New Year
B．Women's Day
C．Spring Festival
questions.explanation: 根据In March, there are Women's Day and Tree Planting Day.可知在三月有妇女节和植树节。故选B。

questions.question:
Mother's Day is in _______.  (   )
A．March
B．May
C．July
questions.explanation: 根据May Day and Mother's Day are in May.可知五一节和母亲节在五月。故选B。

questions.question:
Children's Day and _______ are in June.  (   )
A．May Day
B．Teachers' Day
C．Father's Day
questions.explanation: 根据Children's Day and Father's Day are in June.可知儿童节和父亲节在六月。故选C。

questions.question:
Christmas is on _______.  (   )
A．December 25th
B．October 1st
C．September 10th
questions.explanation: 根据Christmas is on December 25th.可知圣诞节是12月25日。故选A。

passages.content: Jack is an Australian boy. His parents are now in China, too. They are teachers. They teach English. Jack is now in No. 2 Middle School. He is a student. He works very hard. His parents work in No. 8 Middle School. Jack is my good friend. Last Sunday he came to see me. We went to swim in the river near my house that day.

questions.question:
Jack is _________.(   )
A．American
B．Australian
C．English
D．Canadian
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack is ___。根据"Jack is an Australian boy."可知Australian，故选B。

questions.question:
Jack and his parents are ________ now. (   )
A．in America
B．in China
C．in Canada
D．in Australia
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack and his parents are ___ now。根据"His parents are now in China, too."可知in China，故选B。

questions.question:
Jack is in _________.(   )
A．No. 2 Middle School
B．No. 8 Middle School
C．No. 18 Middle School
D．No. 20 Middle School
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack is in ___。根据"2 Middle School."可知No. 2 Middle School，故选A。

questions.question:
Jack came to see me ________.(   )
A．last Sunday
B．last Monday
C．last Thursday
D．last Saturday
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack came to see me ___。根据"Last Sunday he came to see me."可知last Sunday，故选A。

questions.question:
I ________ with Jack that day. (   )
A．went to the shop
B．went out at the cinema
C．went out to play football
D．went to swim
questions.explanation: 句意：I ___ with Jack that day。根据"Last Sunday he came to see me."可知选D。

passages.content:
Most American families are smaller than the families in other countries. Children in the USA will leave their parents when they grow up. They usually live far from their parents because they want to find good jobs. They often write to their parents or telephone them. And they often go to visit their parents on holidays.

Parents usually let their children choose their own jobs. Americans think it is important(重要的) for them to make decisions(作决定).

Children are also asked to do some housework at home. And in many families, children will get money from their parents for doing some housework. Because American parents want to let their children learn how to make money for their own use.

questions.question:
Most Chinese families are ________the families in America.（  ）
A．smaller than
B．as big as
C．bigger than
questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：Most Chinese families are ___the families in America。根据"And in many families, children will get money from their parents for doing some housework."可知bigger than，故选C。

questions.question:
When children grow up, they leave their parents to ________. （  ）
A．get married
B．find good jobs
C．be free
questions.explanation: 句意：When children grow up, they leave their parents to ___。根据"And in many families, children will get money from their parents for doing some housework."可知find good jobs，故选B。

questions.question:
They visit their parents ________. （  ）
A．every day
B．on weekdays
C．on holidays

passages.content:
It’s Sunday afternoon.It’s sunny and warm.Some people are in the garden. They’re Tommy’s family. Today is Tommy’s birthday, and they’re having a birthday party.

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：It’s Sunday afternoon. Tommy’s family are in the ___。根据"Tommy is very happy.He is counting his nice gifts in front of him."可知garden，故选C。

questions.question:
They’re having ________.(　　)

questions.explanation: 句意：They’re having ___。根据"She is cutting the birthday cake."可知a birthday party，故选B。

questions.question:
Tommy is very happy. He is ________.(　　)

B．cutting the birthday cake

questions.explanation: 句意：Tommy is very happy. He is ___。根据"Tommy is very happy.He is counting his nice gifts in front of him."可知counting his gifts，故选C。

questions.question:

questions.question:
What is Tommy’s dad doing? (　　)

passages.content: Tom and John are brothers.They live in the same room and are in the same class.One day they had a fight (打架), so they didn't speak to each other (彼此) for a few days. On Monday evening, Tom was very tired when he came back from school. He went to bed after dinner and didn't say anything to John.John helped his mother with the housework. Then he did homework. When he went to bed, he found a piece of paper on the small table near his bed.It said, “John, wake me up (叫醒) at 7 am.Tom." When Tom was awake the next morning, it was nearly 8 o'clock, and on the small table he saw another piece of paper. It said, "Tom, wake up! It is 7 am.John."

questions.question:

questions.question:
Tom and John didn't speak to each other because they ________. (　　)

questions.explanation: 句意：Tom and John didn't speak to each other because they ___。根据"Tom and John are brothers.They live in the same room and are in the same class.One day they had a fight (打架), so they didn't speak to each other (彼此) for a few days."可知had a fight，故选C。

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 句意：___ was late for school that day。根据"On Monday evening, Tom was very tired when he came back from school."可知Tom，故选A。

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：Where are Ben’s grandparents?。根据"Ben is going to visit his grandparents in New York next week."可知In New York.，故选B。

questions.question:
What did Ben do yesterday? (    )

passages.content:
The students were having their chemistry (化学) class. Miss Li was telling the children what water is like. After that, she asked her students, “What’s water?” No one spoke for a few minutes. Miss Li asked again, “Why don’t you answer my question? Didn’t I tell you what water is like?”

Just then a boy put up his hand and said, “Miss Li, you told us that water has no colour and no smell. But where to find such kind of water? The water in the river behind my house is always black and it has a bad smell.” Most of the children agreed with him. “I’m sorry, children,” said the teacher, “our water is getting dirtier. That’s a problem.”

questions.question:
The students were having their _______ class. (    )
A．English
B．Chinese
C．chemistry
D．maths
questions.explanation: 由句子The students were having their chemistry (化学)class. 学生们正在上化学课。可知答案为C。

questions.question:
Miss Li was telling the children what _______ is like. (    )
A．water
B．air
C．earth
D．weather
questions.explanation: 由句子Miss Li was telling the children what water is like. 李老师正告诉孩子们水是什么样的。可知答案为A。

questions.question:
A boy said, “The water in the river behind my house is always _______.” (    )
A．white
B．black
C．clean
D．clear
questions.explanation: 由句子The water in the river behind my house is always black.我房子后面河里的水是黑色的。可知答案为B。

questions.question:
Most of the children _______ the boy. (    )
A．agreed with
B．wrote to
C．heard from
D．sent for

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 由句子our water is getting dirtier. 我们的水变得更脏。可知答案为 D。

passages.content: Once (从前)a man stole (偷)one of Washington’s horses. Washington went with a policeman to get back the horse. But the man didn’t give the horse to Washington. He said it was his horse. Washington put his hands on the eyes of the horse and said to the man,“If (如果)this is your horse, you must tell us in which eye he is blind (瞎的).”“In the right eye!” the man said. Washington took his hand from the right eye of the horse and showed the policeman that the horse was not blind. “Oh，I made a mistake (弄错了),” said the man.“He is blind in the left eye.” Washington then took his hand from the left eye of the horse. It was not blind in the left eye either (也不).“I made another mistake (又弄错了 ),” said the man. “Yes,” said the policeman, “and you know the horse is not yours. You must give it back to Washington.”

questions.question:
A man stole Washington’s________.(   )
A．money
B．horse
C．monkey
D．rabbit
questions.explanation: 由句子Once a man stole one of Washington’s horses.可知答案选B。

questions.question:
Washington went to get back the horse with________.(   )
A．a policeman
B．a woman
C．his son
D．his father
questions.explanation: Washington went with a policeman to get back the horse.这个句子中with表示和……一起，with引导的成分通常做伴随状语。可以位于句中，也可以位于句尾。get back以为把……拿回来。本句的意思华盛顿和一个警察一起把马找回来。可知答案选A。

passages.content:
In England, people don’t usually talk much. You can go on a bus, or a train, and everyone sits looking out of the window. Often they read. They read books and papers, but they don’t talk much. When you meet English people, they often talk about one thing—the weather. So when you meet somebody in England, you can say, “Nice weather for the time of year!” “But it was a little cold yesterday.” Somebody may answer, “But it got a bit warmer later.” You can say.

Talk like this and the English will think, “How friendly you are!”

questions.question:
English people often _____ on a bus. (   )
A．talk much
B．talk little
C．eat something
D．read papers
questions.explanation: 【分析】本题从第一句可知英国人谈论得很少，故答案为D。

questions.question:
When you meet English people, you can talk like this _____. (   )
A．how do you do
B．how are you
C．Nice weather
D．Nice to meet you
questions.explanation: 本题文中说到，英国人喜欢讨论天气，故答案为C。

questions.question:
If you talk with the English people about the weather, they will think _____. (   )
A．you are friendly
B．you are right
questions.explanation: 本题从文章最后一句像这样谈话，英国人会认为你很友好。故答案为A。

questions.question:
English people always hope the weather will get _____. (   )
A．better
B．warmer
C．colder
D．hotter

questions.question:
Which is right? (   )
A．English people like to talk on a bus.
B．English people didn’t enjoy the best weather.
C．English people are the most friendly.
D．English people don’t talk much.
questions.explanation: 本题从第一句可知英国人谈论得很少选项正确，故答案为D。

passages.content: Wall Street is a famous street in New York City. It got its name from the wooden wall that used to stand where the street now runs. The wall was built in the 1600s. New York was then a Dutch (荷兰的) city set up by people coming from Holland in Europe, it was called New Amsterdam. The American Indians were not always friends of the Dutch, nor were the English. So the Dutch built the wooden wall to protect their town. The wall is gone now,            but Wall Street reminds (提醒) the people of New York of the Dutch who settled there.

questions.question:
New Amsterdam was the name of ______. (   )
A．a wall
B．a street
C．a city in Holland
D．a city in America
questions.explanation: 【分析】从第三行可以看出，New Amsterdam就是New York, 所以应该是美国的一个城市。

questions.question:
The wall was built ______. (   )
A．by the English against the Americans and the Indians
B．by the Dutch against the Indians and Americans
C．by the English against the Dutch and Indians
D．by the Dutch against the Indians and the English
questions.explanation: 本题从第二段可以得出答案。

questions.question:
New York was originally (最早) built by _____. (   )

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 从最后一段第一句，the wll is gone now. 说明那堵墙现在已经没有了。

passages.content:

His grandma lives in a small town. One day she comes to see him. It’s Saturday and she doesn’t see Mark at home. So she goes to look for him in the school. She sees many boys running after only one ball. questions.question:
