questions.question: Lucy is a 12-year-old student. (     )
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：露西是一名12岁的学生。根据“I’m twelve years old.”可知露西12岁。

questions.question: Lucy likes hamburgers best. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：露西最喜欢汉堡包。根据“I don’t like hamburgers.”可知露西不喜欢汉堡包。

questions.question: Lucy went to school yesterday. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：露西昨天去上学了。根据“Yesterday was Saturday. I didn’t go to school.”可知露西昨天没有上学。

questions.question: Lucy played football in the park on Saturday afternoon. (     )

questions.question: Lucy is going to visit her grandparents on Sunday. (     )

passages.content:
Zhang Wei is a Grade Six student. He lives in a big city. There are many tall buildings, big supermarkets and a science museum near his home. There are lots of buses and cars on the road. He went to school by bus before, but now he goes to school by subway. It’s faster. Zhang Wei’s favourite subject is science. He wants to be an engineer in the future. After school, he joins the robot club. At weekends, he often reads books in the city library.  Sometimes he visits the science museum. There are many interesting inventions there.

Liu Yu is Zhang Wei’s cousin. She lives in a small village. There are many houses with big yards. There are green trees and colourful flowers everywhere. She can hear birds sing every morning. Liu Yu went to school on foot before, but now she goes to school by school bus. Her favourite subject is English. She wants to be an English teacher in the village. After school, she often helps her parents feed the chickens and ducks on the farm. At weekends, she picks fruits in the orchard with her family.

questions.question: Zhang Wei goes to school by bus now. (       )
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：张伟现在坐公交去上学。根据“He went to school by bus before, but now he goes to school by subway.”可知张伟现在坐地铁去上学。

questions.question: Zhang Wei wants to be a scientist in the future. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：张伟将来想成为一名科学家。根据“He wants to be an engineer in the future.”可知张伟将来想成为一名工程师。

questions.question: Liu Yu lives in a village, and there are many trees and flowers there. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：刘宇住在一个村庄，那里有许多树和花。根据“She lives in a small village. There are green trees and colourful flowers everywhere.”可知刘宇住在一个村庄，那里有许多树和花。

questions.question: Liu Yu’s favourite subject is English, and she wants to be a teacher. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：刘宇最喜欢的科目是英语，她想成为一名老师。根据“Her favourite subject is English. She wants to be an English teacher in the village.”可知刘宇最喜欢的科目是英语，她想成为一名老师。

questions.question: Zhang Wei often helps his parents feed animals at weekends. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：张伟周末经常帮他父母喂动物。根据“After school, she (Liu Yu) often helps her parents feed the chickens and ducks on the farm.”可知是刘宇放学后经常帮父母喂动物，不是张伟。

passages.content: Hello, I’m Peter. My winter holidays were wonderful. I went back to Canada with my parents. I visited my friends in Ottawa and took many beautiful pictures there. We went ice fishing together and it was very fun. On the Lantern Festival, I watched the parade on TV and saw the yangge dance. I also guessed some riddles with my sister and got a small prize. I had a good time in the holidays.

questions.question: Peter went back to the US in the winter holidays. (       )
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：彼得在寒假回到了美国。根据“I went back to Canada with my parents.”可知彼得和父母回了加拿大。

questions.question: Peter visited his friends in Ottawa. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得去渥太华看望了他的朋友。根据“I visited my friends in Ottawa and took many beautiful pictures there.”可知彼得去渥太华看望了他的朋友，并在那里拍了许多漂亮的照片。

questions.question: Peter took many pictures in Canada. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得在加拿大拍了很多照片。根据“I visited my friends in Ottawa and took many beautiful pictures there.”可知彼得去渥太华看望了他的朋友，并在那里拍了许多漂亮的照片。渥太华是加拿大的首都。

questions.question: Peter didn’t go ice fishing with his friends. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得没有和他的朋友去冰钓。根据“We went ice fishing together and it was very fun.”可知彼得和他的朋友去冰钓，很有趣。

questions.question: Peter got a prize when he guessed riddles. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得猜谜时得了奖。根据“I also guessed some riddles with my sister and got a small prize.”可知彼得还和姐姐猜了一些谜语，得了一个小奖。

passages.content: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. It usually comes in January or February. Before the Spring Festival, people always clean their houses, buy new clothes and a lot of delicious food. On the eve of the Spring Festival, all the family members get together, have a big dinner and watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV. Children love the Spring Festival very much, because they can get lucky money from their parents and grandparents. They can also set off firecrackers with their friends. During the Spring Festival, people visit their relatives and friends, and say “Happy New Year” to each other. Everyone has a good time during the Spring Festival.

questions.question: The Spring Festival usually comes in September or October. (      )
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：春节通常在九月或十月到来。根据“It usually comes in January or February.”可知春节通常在1月或2月。

questions.question: People often clean their houses before the Spring Festival. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：人们经常在春节前打扫房屋。根据“Before the Spring Festival, people always clean their houses, buy new clothes and a lot of delicious food.”可知表达正确。

questions.question: On the eve of the Spring Festival, families have a big dinner together. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：除夕夜，一家人在一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。根据“On the eve of the Spring Festival, all the family members get together, have a big dinner and watch the Spring Festival Gala on TV.”可知表达正确。

questions.question: Children can get lucky money from their teachers at the Spring Festival. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：春节孩子们可以从老师那里得到压岁钱。根据“Children love the Spring Festival very much, because they can get lucky money from their parents and grandparents.”可知是从父母和祖父母那里得到压岁钱。

questions.question: People visit their relatives and friends during the Spring Festival. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：人们在春节期间走亲访友。根据“During the Spring Festival, people visit their relatives and friends, and say “Happy New Year” to each other.”可知表达正确。

passages.content: Once upon a time, some children found a turtle. They began to beat the turtle. At that time, a man came and said, “Stop!” The children ran away quickly. The turtle was very thankful to him and gave him two boxes. The turtle said, “Here are two boxes, but you can open only one. You mustn’t open both. Don’t forget it!” “All right. I will open only one,” the young man promised. After he went back home, he opened the bigger one of the two boxes. The box was full of gold. “My God!” he cried. “I’m rich now.” Then he thought, “Things in the other box must be expensive too.” He broke his promise and opened the other box. As soon as he opened it, he became an old man. His hair turned white. His face looked like an old man over eighty years old. It happened in a moment. He was sorry for what he did, but it was too late.

questions.question: The turtle was saved by an old man a long time ago. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：很久之前这只乌龟被一个老人救了。原文里救乌龟的是年轻人，不是老人，句子与原文不符。

questions.question: The turtle gave two boxes to the man and told him to open all of them. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：乌龟给了男人两个盒子，还让他把两个都打开。由文中“Here are two boxes, but you can open only one. You mustn’t open both. Don’t forget it!” 可知乌龟明确要求只能打开一个，不能开两个。句子与原文不符。

questions.question: The man opened one of the boxes. It was full of gold. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：男人打开了其中一个盒子，盒子里装满了金子。由文中“After he went back home, he opened the bigger one of the two boxes. The box was full of gold.” 可知男人打开了较大的那个箱子，装满了黄金。句子与原文相符。

questions.question: The man didn’t keep his promise at last. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：男人最后没有遵守承诺。由文中“He broke his promise and opened the other box.” 男人原本承诺只开一个盒子，后来打破承诺打开了另一个。句子与原文相符。

questions.question: The man regretted opening the first box because he became old. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：男人后悔打开第一个盒子，因为他变老了。原文里男人是打开第二个盒子后才变老的，他后悔的是打开第二个盒子，不是第一个，句子与原文不符。

passages.content: It was Ben’s birthday yesterday. There was a big birthday cake on the desk. And there are twelve candles (蜡烛) on the cake. Daming played the piano and Simon played the guitar. Ben got lots of presents from his family and friends. Tom gave Ben a new pen. Nancy gave him a CD．Maomao gave him a card. Then they sang the song Happy Birthday to You to Ben. Ben was very happy.

questions.question: The children had a picnic. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：孩子们去野餐。根据短文内容可知孩子们没有去野餐，题干与短文内容不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: There was a small birthday cake on the desk. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：桌子上有一个小的生日蛋糕。根据“There was a big birthday cake on the desk.”可知桌子上有一个大的生日蛋糕，题干与短文内容不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: Ben was twelve years old yesterday. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：本昨天12岁了。根据“And there are twelve candles (蜡烛) on the cake.”可知本昨天12岁了，题干与短文内容相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Daming played the piano and Simon played the guitar. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：大明弹钢琴，西蒙弹吉他。根据“Daming played the piano and Simon played the guitar.”可知大明弹钢琴，西蒙弹吉他，题干与短文内容相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Then they sang the song Happy Birthday to You to Ben. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：然后他们为本唱生日快乐歌。根据“Then they sang the song Happy Birthday to You	to Ben.”可知然后他们为本唱生日快乐歌，题干与短文内容相符，故答案为T。

passages.content:
This is the food pyramid. Follow this, it can make you healthy. At the bottom are bread, rice and noodles. Above them are vegetables and fruit. We should have a lot of them because they have vitamins.

Sweet food is at the top. It’s nice, but it is not good for your teeth. Eat only a little sweet food everyday. Eggs, meat, fish and milk are below the sweet food. You can have some meat and fish in your meals. You can also have a few eggs every week. Milk is good for your body. You can have some milk every day.

questions.question: We should eat lots of vegetables and fruit because they have vitamins. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我们应该多吃蔬菜和水果，因为它们含有维生素。根据“Above them are vegetables and fruit. We should have a lot of them because they have vitamins. ”可知我们应该多吃蔬菜和水果，因为它们含有维生素，题干与短文内容相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: We need to eat a lot of eggs. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我们需要吃很多鸡蛋。根据“You can also have a few eggs every week.”可知每周吃几个鸡蛋就可以了，题干与短文内容不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: Sweet food is good for our body. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：甜食对我们的身体有好处。根据“Sweet food is at the top. It’s nice, but it is not good for your teeth. ”可知甜食对我们的身体并非有好处，题干与短文内容不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: We can eat much meat and fish in a meal. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：我们可以一顿饭吃很多肉和鱼。根据“You can have some meat and fish in your meals.”可知我们可以一顿饭吃一些肉和鱼，不是吃很多肉和鱼，题干与短文内容不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: Having a healthy diet is good for our health. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干句意：健康的饮食对我们的健康有好处。根据“This is the food pyramid. Follow this, it can make you healthy.”可知健康的饮食对我们的健康有好处，题干与短文内容相符，故答案为T。

passages.content: Hello! I’m Lily. I’m twelve years old. I’m from China. I like reading books and playing basketball. I have a good friend. Her name is Amy. She is from America. She is eleven years old. She likes singing and dancing. We often play together on weekends.

questions.question: Lily is eleven years old. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉十一岁。根据“I’m Lily. I’m twelve years old.”，可知莉莉十二岁，故答案为F。

questions.question: Lily is from China. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉来自中国。根据“I’m Lily. I’m twelve years old. I’m from China.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Amy likes reading books and playing basketball. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米喜欢读书和打篮球。根据“I like reading books and playing basketball.”，可知莉莉喜欢读书和打篮球，故答案为F。

questions.question: Lily and Amy often play together on weekends. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉和艾米经常在周末一起玩。根据“We often play together on weekends.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Amy is twelve years old. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米十二岁了。根据“Her name is Amy. She is from America. She is eleven years old.”，可知艾米十一岁，故答案为F。

passages.content:
Hello! I’m Sarah.I’m 12 years old. I’m thin, and I’m 1.50 metres tall. I like reading books. My father is an engineer. He is 0.25 metres taller than me. He goes to work by car. My mother works in a supermarket. She goes to work by bike. I usually go to school on foot, because my home is not far from the school.

Today is Friday. After school, I played basketball with my friends. I was tired. And tomorrow is Saturday. I will go to the hospital with my mother, because she is ill. On Sunday morning, I’m going to wash clothes. In the afternoon, I’m going to the library with Chen Jie. I will have a busy weekend.

questions.question: Sarah’s father is 1.75 metres tall. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：萨拉的父亲身高1.75米。根据文中“I’m thin, and I’m 1.50 metres tall.”和“He is 0.25 metres taller than me.”可知萨拉的父亲身高1.75米。故答案为T。

questions.question: Sarah’s mother works in the library. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：萨拉的妈妈在图书馆工作。根据文中“My mother works in a supermarket.”可知萨拉的妈妈在一家超市工作。故答案为F。

questions.question: Sarah’s home is far from the school. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：萨拉的家离学校很远。根据文中“I usually go to school on foot, because my home is not far from the school.”可知萨拉的家离学校不远。故答案为F。

questions.question: Sarah is ill, and she is going to the hospital. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：萨拉病了，她要去医院。根据文中“I will go to the hospital with my mother, because she is ill.”可知萨拉的妈妈病了，她要去医院。故答案为F。

questions.question: Sarah is going to the library with Chen Jie on Sunday afternoon. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：萨拉将于周日下午和陈杰一起去图书馆。根据文中“On Sunday morning, I’m going to wash clothes.In the afternoon, I’m going to the library with Chen Jie.”可知萨拉将于周日下午和陈杰一起去图书馆。故答案为T。

passages.content: The Spring Festival is Chinese New Year. It usually comes in February. Almost everybody in China likes the Spring Festival very much. When the Spring Festival comes, people clean the houses and buy new clothes. In the first day of the festival, most people in China eat dumplings and cook a lot of delicious food for dinner. After dinner, all family will watch Spring Festival Gala. Children will get red packet on this day too.

questions.question: The Spring Festival is Chinese New Year. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：春节是中国的新年。根据“The Spring Festival is Chinese New Year.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: When the Spring Festival comes, people will buy new clothes. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：当春节来临时，人们会买新衣服。根据“When the Spring Festival comes, people clean the houses and buy new clothes.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: People will cook a lot of delicious food for lunch. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：人们午餐会做很多美味的食物。根据“In the first day of the festival, most people in China eat dumplings and cook a lot of delicious food for dinner.”，可知人们晚餐会做很多美味的食物，故答案为F。

questions.question: After dinner will watch Spring Festival Gala. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：晚饭后，人们看春晚。根据“After dinner, all family will watch Spring Festival Gala.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Everyone will get red packet on that day. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：那天每个人都会得到红包。根据“Children will get red packet on this day too.”，可知孩子们会得到红包，故答案为F。

passages.content:
Wang Bing: Yang Ling, what did you do last Sunday?
Yang Ling: I visited Lin Tao’s grandparents.
Wang Bing: Where do they live?
Yang Ling: They live in a small town near Nanjing. They have a really nice house. I went there with Su Hai, Su Yang, Gao Shan, Lin Tao and Ben. They were very glad to see us. Lin Tao’s grandpa showed us a lot of stamps from different countries. His grandma cooked us a nice lunch. We liked the food very much.
Wang Bing: What did you do there?
Yang Ling: In the morning, we cleaned their house. In the afternoon, we worked in their garden. Su Hai and Su Yang watered the trees and flowers. Lin Tao and Gao Shan picked apples. Ben and I planted some trees. We worked for about two hours (小时).
Wang Bing: Were you tired?
Yang Ling: No! I like working in the garden. We had a really good time.
Wang Bing: Great! I’d like to visit them, too.

questions.question: Wang Bing and Yang Ling visited Lin Tao’s grandparents last Sunday. (    )
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日，王冰和杨玲看望了林涛的爷爷奶奶。根据“Wang Bing: Yang Ling, what did you do last Sunday? Yang Ling: I visited Lin Tao’s grandparents.”，可知王兵没去，故答案为F。

questions.question: Lin Tao’s grandpa showed them a lot of stamps. (    )
questions.explanation: 句意：林涛的爷爷给他们看了很多邮票。根据“Lin Tao’s grandpa showed us a lot of stamps from different countries.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Lin Tao’s grandma cooked us a nice lunch. (    )
questions.explanation: 句意：林涛的奶奶给我们做了一顿丰盛的午餐。根据“His grandma cooked us a nice lunch.”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Yang Ling and Su Hai planted flowers. (    )
questions.explanation: 句意：杨玲和苏海种了花。根据“Ben and I planted some trees.”，可知本和杨玲种了树，故答案为F。

questions.question: They worked on the farm for about two hours. (    )
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在农场工作了大约两个小时。根据“We worked for about two hours (小时).”，可知题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

passages.content: Hello, I’m Jenny. Let me tell you something about schools in Australia (澳大利亚). Usually, there is no school uniform. Classes start at 8:30 every morning and school is over at 3:30 or 4 o’clock. Students have one hour for lunch and two 20-minute breaks (休息) each day. One break is in the morning, and the other is in the afternoon. Students often go to the school cafeteria (餐厅) at lunch time or at break. They can buy food and drinks there. Football, baseball and basketball are popular activities after school.

questions.question: Students in Australia do not usually wear school uniforms. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：澳大利亚的学生通常不穿校服。根据句子“Usually, there is no school uniform.”，可知澳大利亚的学生通常不穿校服，题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Classes start at 8:00 every morning. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：每天早上八点开始上课。根据句子“Classes start at 8:30 every morning and school is over at 3:30 or 4 o’clock.”，可知每天早上8点半上课，题干与短文不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: Students have two hours for break after lunch. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：午饭后学生有两个小时的休息时间。根据句子“Students have one hour for lunch and two 20-minute breaks each day.”，可知休息时间是20分钟，题干与短文不符，故答案为F。

questions.question: Students can have food or drinks in the school cafeteria. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们可以在学校的自助餐厅里吃食物或喝饮料。根据句子“Students often go to the school cafeteria at lunch time or at break. They can buy food and drinks there.”，可知学生们可以在学校的自助餐厅里吃食物或喝饮料，题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

questions.question: Many students play football, baseball or basketball after school. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：许多学生放学后踢足球、打棒球或篮球。根据句子“Football, baseball and basketball are popular activities after school.”，可知学生们放学后踢足球、打棒球或篮球，题干与短文相符，故答案为T。

passages.content:
A wolf and a fox wanted to eat a rabbit, but it wasn’t easy for them to catch him. One day, the wolf said to the fox, “You go home and lie (躺) in bed. I’ll tell the rabbit that you are dead. When he comes to your house, you can jump up and catch him.”

“That’s a good idea,” said the fox. Then the fox went home. The wolf went to the rabbit’s home and told the rabbit that the fox was dead. The rabbit went to the fox’s house. Hе looked in through the window and saw the fox. The fox stayed in bed and closed his eyes. He didn’t know whether (是否) the fox was dead, so he said, “The fox doesn’t look like a dead fox. I study in the same school. I am happy here, because I like my new school and the classmates. They are very kind to me. They like to play with me because I look different from them. I have blue eyes and long blond hair. They often say I look like a doll. Also I speak English well, so lots of students like to talk with me to improve (提高) their English.

questions.question: There are five people in Nancy’s family. (       )
questions.explanation: 【详解】句意：There are five people in Nancy’s family。根据短文内容可知表述错误。

questions.question: Nancy’s parents are teachers. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：Nancy’s parents are teachers。根据"I live with my parents, two sisters and a brother in Guangdong."可知表述正确。

questions.question: Nancy’s classmates are kind to her. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：Nancy’s classmates are kind to her。根据"I am happy here, because I like my new school and the classmates."可知表述正确。

questions.question: Nancy’s eyes are black. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：Nancy’s eyes are black。根据"I have blue eyes and long blond hair."可知表述错误。

questions.question: Nancy’s English is very good. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：Nancy’s English is very good。根据"My parents teach English in No."可知表述正确。

passages.content:
Mr. White is an English man. He is a teacher. He teaches English in No.1 Primary School in HongKong. He likes teaching very much. He goes to work by car every morning.

There are thirty students in his class. He speaks English with them in class. He plays games with them after class. He likes them very much. And his students love him, too. They are good friends.

questions.question: Mr. White is a Germany. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：Mr. White is a Germany。根据短文内容可知表述错误。

questions.question: He very likes teaching English. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：very喜欢teaching English。根据"He speaks English with them in class."可知表述正确。

questions.question: He goes to work by bus every morning. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：He goes to work by bus every morning。根据短文内容可知表述错误。

questions.question: He speaks Chinese in class. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：He speaks Chinese in class。根据"He speaks English with them in class."可知表述错误。

questions.question: Mr. Black’s students like him very much. (     )
questions.explanation: 句意：students喜欢him very much。根据"And his students love him, too."可知表述正确。

passages.content: Today is Sunday. I want to go to the park. But I don’t know the way to the park. My father tells me the way to the park. It is far from my home. First, I take the No. 2 bus. I get off at the bank. I turn right at the bank. Then I go straight for five minutes. I can see a big park on the right. It’s next to the science museum.

questions.question: Tomorrow is Saturday. (      )
questions.explanation: 【解析】句意：Tomorrow is Saturday。根据短文内容可知表述错误。

questions.question: I ask a policeman for help. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：I ask a policeman for help。根据短文内容可知表述错误。

questions.question: The park is far from my home. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：The park is far from my home。根据"But I don’t know the way to the park."可知表述正确。

questions.question: I get to the park in 5 minutes. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：I get to the park in 5 minutes。根据"But I don’t know the way to the park."可知表述错误。

questions.question: The park is next to the science museum. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：The park is next to the science museum。根据"It’s next to the science museum."可知表述正确。

passages.content: The Whites always get up early every day. In the morning Father always goes to work. Allan and Sue always go to school. Mother usually stays at home. At noon, Allan and Sue always have lunch at school. In the afternoon, Allan and Sue come from school. They usually arrive home early. In the evening, Allan and Sue always do their homework. At night, they go to bed early, but it's difficult for them to fall asleep.

questions.question: The Whites means all the members of Mr White's family. (    )
questions.explanation: 【解析】句子意思是“The Whites意思是指Mr. White全家人”。可知答案为T。

questions.question: Allan is Mr White's daughter and Sue is his son. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子Allan和Sue都是女孩的名字，不是题目中的Allan是Mr White的女儿，Sue是他的儿子。可知答案为F，

questions.question: Mr White, Allan and Sue leave home in the morning except Mrs White. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子In the morning father always goes to work. Allan and Sue always go to school. Mother usually stays at home.上午，爸爸总是去上班。Allan和Sue总是去上学。妈妈通常待在家里。跟题目中“除了Mrs. White之外，Mr. White, Allan 和Sue都离开家”意思一样，可知答案为T。

questions.question: Allan and Sue can get home early in the afternoon. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子In the afternoon. Allan and Sue come from school. They usually arrive home early.在下午，Allan和Sue从学校回来。她们通常早到家。跟题目表达的意思一样，答案为T。

questions.question: Allan and Sue like sleeping. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子At night, they go to bed early, but it's difficult for them to fall asleep.在晚上，他们早早地去睡觉，但是入睡对她们来说很难。而题目中的句子意思是“Allan和Sue喜欢睡觉”，意思不一致，答案为F

passages.content:
Wu Dong has a good friend. His name is Peter. He is from the U.S.A．Wu Dong and Peter are in the same class. They go to school five days a week. They stay at home on Sunday and Saturday. Peter likes China and Chinese food. He likes rice cakes very much. At school they play table tennis (乒乓球)after class.

Wu Dong and Peter like making things. Now they are making a plane. They like flying planes on Sunday morning. Peter speaks English and a little Chinese. Wu Dong speaks Chinese and a little English. They teach each other.

questions.question: Wu Dong has an American friend. (      )
questions.explanation: 【解析】由文中的句子Wu Dong has a good friend. His name is Peter. He is from the USA.可知本句答案为T。

questions.question: They go to school from Monday to Friday. (      )
questions.explanation: 由句子They go to school five days a week. They stay at home on Sunday and Saturday.可知本句答案为T。

questions.question: They often fly planes after class. (      )
questions.explanation: 由句子At school they play table tennis after class.可知本句答案为F。

questions.question: Wu Dong teaches Peter English and Peter teaches Wu Dong Chinese. (      )
questions.explanation: 由句子Peter speaks English and a little Chinese . Wu Dong speaks Chinese and a little English. They teach each other.可知本句答案为F。

questions.question: Peter often eats rice cakes because he likes eating them. (      )
questions.explanation: 由句子He likes rice cakes very much.可知他喜欢吃，文中没有体现经常吃的句子，这个句子只属于推测没有依据。故答案为F。

passages.content: I’m Fangfang. I live in a village. It’s small but beautiful. Look! That is my house. There are some trees near it. Behind the house there’s a big river. You can see boats on the river. Many ducks are beside the boats. How lovely! Oh, many flowers are among (在……之中) the trees. Let’s get some for our teachers.

questions.question: Fangfang’s house is small. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】题干是芳芳的房子是小的。由第二、三句I live in a village. It’s small but beautiful. （我住在一个村庄。它很小但是很漂亮。）可知是芳芳的村庄小，短文中并未提及芳芳的房子的大小。所以答案是F。

questions.question: There’s a small river behind the house. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干是在房子后面有一条小河。由句子Behind the house there’s a big river.在房子的后面有一条大河。可知答案是F。

questions.question: There are some boats on the river. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干是在河上有一些船。由句子You can see boats on the river. （你可以看到在河面上有很多船。）可知答案是T。

questions.question: What lovely ducks they are! (     )
questions.explanation: 题干是这些鸭子多么可爱啊！由句子Many ducks are beside the boats. How lovely!（在船边有很多鸭子，多么可爱！）可知答案是T。

questions.question: Some flowers among the trees are for our English teachers. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干是在树丛中的这些花是给我们的英语老师的。由句子Oh, many flowers are among (在……之中）the trees.Let’s get some for our teachers.（哦，在树丛之中有很多花。让我们摘一些送给我们的老师们吧。）可知不仅是给英语老师，是所有的老师们。所以答案是F。

passages.content:
Long long ago, there was a poor(穷)man. He had an orange tree. On the tree, there were many fine oranges. One of them was very big. It was as big as a ball. Nobody saw so big an orange. The poor man was very happy. He gave it to the King (国王).The King was so glad that he gave the man a lot of money for it.

When a rich man heard of it, he said to himself, “It was only an orange. Why did the King give so much money for him? I would take my gold (金的)cup to the King. He would give me more money.”

The next day when the King got the gold cup, he said to the rich man, "What a beautiful cup! I would show you something wonderful. This big orange is for you.”

questions.question: The rich man had an apple tree.  (       )
questions.explanation: 题干意思：这个富人有一棵苹果树。由句子Long long ago, there was a poor(穷)man. He had an orange tree.很久以前，有一个穷人。他有一棵橘子树。可知本题错误，即F。

questions.question: One of the oranges was round and big as a ball. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：其中的一个句子很圆而且和球一样大。由句子One of them was very big. It was as big as a ball.（他们其中的一个很大。和球一样大。. 可知本题正确，即T。

questions.question: The rich man wanted the big orange. (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：这个富人想要这个大橘子。由句子I would take my gold (金的)cup to the King. He would give me more money.我把我的金杯带去给国王。他肯定会给我更多的钱。可知答案是F。

questions.question: The rich man was not happy at last (最后). (       )
questions.explanation: 句意：最后这个富人很不高兴。 由句子I would take my gold (金的)cup to the King. He would give me more money. 我把我的金杯带去给国王。他肯定会给我更多的钱。.这是这个富人想的。和句子：The next day when the King got the gold cup, he said to the rich man, “What a beautiful cup! I would show you something wonderful. This big orange is for you.”第二天国王得到了这个金杯，他对富人说“多么漂亮的杯子！我将要给你一些很棒的东西。这个大橘子给你。 可知富人没有得到他想要的更多钱，他肯定不高兴。所以本题答案是T。

passages.content: How are you? I miss you. I went to Hainan with Dad and Mom Last weekend. It is really a wonderful place. We walked on the beach, swam in the sea, ate good food and watched a very beautiful dance. It was so hot in Hainan, but we had a good time there. Here is a photo for you, Hope you like it. Please write to me soon.

questions.question: Amy went to Hainan with Dad and Mom last Monday. (      )
questions.explanation: 【分析】句意：Amy went to Hainan with Dad and Mom last Monday。根据"I went to Hainan with Dad and Mom Last weekend."可知表述错误。

questions.question: Hainan is really a wonderful place. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：Hainan is really a wonderful place。根据"It is really a wonderful place."可知表述正确。

questions.question: Amy and her parents watched a very beautiful dance. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：Amy and her parents watched a very beautiful dance。根据"We walked on the beach, swam in the sea, ate good food and watched a very beautiful dance."可知表述正确。

questions.question: It was so cold in Hainan. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：It was so cold in Hainan。根据"I went to Hainan with Dad and Mom Last weekend."可知表述错误。

questions.question: Chenjie and her parents had a good time there. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：Chenjie and her parents had a good time there。根据"It was so hot in Hainan, but we had a good time there."可知表述正确。

passages.content: All the students in China are learning English, but how can they learn English well? Some students can know a lot about English, they can do some exercises, but perhaps they can’t speak English loudly. If you want to know how to swim, you must get into the river. And if you want to be a football player, you must play football. So, you see, you can learn English by using (使用) it. You must listen to your teacher in class. You must speak English to your classmates everyday and also you must watch some English cartoons, sing some English songs, write some English diaries.... Then one day you may find you can speak very good English.

questions.question: All the people in the world are learning English. (    )
questions.explanation: 【解析】由第一句All the students in China are learning English. 可知在中国的所有学生正在学英语，而不是世界所有的人正在学英语。答案是F。

questions.question: Knowing a lot about English is different from speaking English. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子 Some students can know a lot about English, they can do some exercises, but perhaps they can’t speak English loudly. 许多学生可能关于英语知道很多，他们能做许多练习，但是也许他们不能大声讲英语。可知 知道很多英语不同于讲英语，答案是T。

questions.question: You can swim without (没有)water. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子If you want to know how to swim, you must get into the river. 如果你想知道如何游泳，你必须下到河里。可知答案是F。

questions.question: You should listen to your teacher in class. (    )
questions.explanation: 由句子You must listen to your teacher in class. 得知你必须在课堂上听你的老师讲课。本题答案是T

questions.question: You can learn English by listening, speaking, reading and writing. (    )
questions.explanation: 由文章最后一段可知，你可以通读听、说、读、写来学习英语，答案是T。

passages.content: My friend, Jack works hard in a factory during the weekdays. At the weekends he always does different things. On Saturdays he goes fishing and on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car. His uncle and aunt have a farm there. It isn’t a big one，but there’s always much to do on the farm. The children help them with the animals and give them their food. Jack and his wife help them in the fields. At the end of the day, they are all tired and Jack’s aunt give them a big meal.

questions.question: Jack works hard in a factory on weekdays. (       )
questions.explanation: 【解析】由Jack works hard in a factory during the weekdays.可知本题是正确的，故填T。

questions.question: I usually does different things on the weekend. (       )
questions.explanation: 由At the weekends he always does different things.可知是he即Jack，而不是I ，故填F。

questions.question: Jack’s uncle and aunt live in the village. (       )
questions.explanation: .由on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car.和His uncle and aunt have a farm there.可知本题是正确的，故填T。

questions.question: Jack goes fishing and to a village with his family. (       )
questions.explanation: 由On Saturdays he goes fishing and on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car.可知这两件事不是在同一在完成的，故本题是错误的，填F。

questions.question: Jack’s aunt’s farm is big. (       )
questions.explanation: 由It isn’t a big one.可知农场并不大，故填F。

passages.content: Mrs. White has two children. John is seven. Ann is only three. John is a good brother. He is always very nice to his sister. One day in the afternoon, Mrs. White is cooking dinner in the kitchen, the two children are playing games in the garden. Suddenly, Ann begins to cry (哭) and she runs to her mother in the kitchen. Mrs. White asks: “What’s wrong with you, Ann?” “John broke (弄坏) my Barbie doll.” Ann answers sadly. “How did he do that?” Mum asks. Ann stops crying and says, “I hit (打) John’s, head with my Barbie doll.”

questions.question: Ann is four years younger than John. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】题干意为Ann比John年轻四岁。根据原文中的第二、三句John is seven. Ann is only three.可知John七岁，而Ann三岁，因此Ann是比John小四岁，故本题论述正确。

questions.question: The two children are playing games and their mother is busy in the kitchen. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意为这两个孩子正在玩游戏，他们的妈妈正在厨房里忙碌。根据原文第六句One day in the afternoon, Mrs. White is cooking dinner in the kitchen, the two children are playing games in the garden.可知本题论述正确。

questions.question: Ann begins to cry because John broke her toy car. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意为 Ann因为John弄坏了她的玩具小汽车而开始哭泣。根据原文倒数第三句：“John broke (弄坏）my Barbie doll.” Ann answers sadly.可知是因为弄坏了她的芭比娃娃而哭泣的，故本题论述错误。

questions.question: “Sadly” means very happy. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意为Sadly意思是非常开心。根据前文Ann哭泣以及sadly词的本身含义为伤心地，可知本题论述错误。

questions.question: In fact (事实上), John is not a good brother. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意为事实上，John不是一个好哥哥。根据原文最后一句Ann stops crying and says，“I hit (打）John’s, head with my Barbie doll.”可知事实是Ann先用芭比娃娃打了她哥哥，因此可知John并不是一个坏哥哥，因此本题论述错误。

passages.content: Teddy has a good friend. His name is Peter. He is from the U.S. Teddy and Peter are in the same class. They go to school five days a week. They stay at home on Sundays and Saturdays. Peter likes China and Chinese food. His favourite Chinese food is dumplings. At school they play table tennis. After class, Teddy and Peter like making things. Now they are making a model plane. They like flying planes on Sunday morning. Peter speaks English and a little Chinese. Teddy speaks Chinese and a little English. They teach each other (互相).

questions.question: Teddy has an American friend. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】由Teddy has a good friend. His name is Peter. He is from the U. S..“泰迪有一个好朋友，他叫彼得，他来自美国。”

questions.question: They don’t go to school on weekends. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子They stay at home on Sundays and Saturdays. “他们周六周日待在家里”。

questions.question: They often fly planes after class. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子After class, Teddy and Peter like making things.“课后，泰迪和彼得喜欢制作东西。”

questions.question: Teddy teaches Peter English. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子Peter speaks English and a little Chinese.Teddy speaks Chinese and a little English. They teach each other (互相）得知他们是互相教彼此。

questions.question: Peter likes dumplings very much. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子Peter likes China and Chinese food. His favourite Chinese food is dumplings. “彼得喜欢中国和中国食物，他最喜欢的中国食物是饺子”。

passages.content: In some parts of the world there are large deserts. There are no trees and no water there. Travelers must take food and water with them. The only animal that can walk through the desert is the camel. It can go without food or water for a long time and it can carry heavy things. People call the camel “the ship of the desert”. The camel’s humps(驼峰) hold fat, and its stomach(胃) holds water in twelve deep pockets. Each pockets has a mouth which closes, and the food does not mix (混合)with the water. When the camel wants some water it can get it out of the pockets. The camel’s food is grass and leaves of trees.

questions.question: Camels can walk through the desert because they don’t drink or eat. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】It can go without food or water for a long time. 可知它可以不吃不喝水走好长一段时间，而不是 因为他们不吃不喝所以骆驼能走过沙漠。答案是F。

questions.question: People call the camels “the ship of the desert”，because all camels can swim in the desert. (     )
questions.explanation: 句子It can go without food or water for a long time and it can carry heavy things. People call the camel “the ship of the desert”.可知，它能不吃不喝水走好长一段时间并能驮重的东西人们叫它们“沙漠之舟”，而不是因为所有的骆驼能在沙漠里游泳所以人们叫它们“沙漠之舟”。答案是F。

questions.question: All camels have less than three humps. (     )
questions.explanation: 句子The camel’s humps（驼峰）hold fat. 和上下文可知 骆驼的驼峰含有脂肪 ，因此 所有的骆驼有不到三个驼峰 是F。

questions.question: Every camel, even the young, has got twelve pockets in its stomach.  (     )
questions.explanation: 句子The camel’s humps （驼峰）hold fat, and its stomach （胃）holds water in twelve deep pockets.可知，每匹骆驼，即使小，胃里面都有十二个室。本题答案是T。

questions.question: Camels eat only grass. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子The camel’s food is grass and leaves of trees. 可知，骆驼的食物是草和树叶，而不是只吃草，答案是F。

passages.content:
Mr Brown is almost 70 years old. He started a club. It is a walking club. There are now ten people in the club and most of them are old people like himself. The people walk two miles every day. They walk very quickly because that is the best way to stay in shape. When it is too cold to walk outside, they walk in a shopping mall. They all wear T-shirts that say I Love Walking.”

Something funny happened to the walking club one day. A dog began to follow them. Soon, there were two more dogs. Now the walking club has both people and dogs walking every day.

questions.question: Mr. Brown started a walking club. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】根据He started a club.确定主语是Mr Brown , 所以答案为T。

questions.question: Most of the people in the Walking Club are old. (     )
questions.explanation: 根据most of them are old people like himself. 大部分人像他自己一样老所以答案为T。

questions.question: People in the Walking Club all wear jeans and T-shirts that say “I love you”. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子 They all wear T-shirts that say I Love Walking.”他们都穿印有我爱步行的T恤衫， 所以题干里的I love you不对，可知答案为F。

questions.question: When it is too cold in winter, they don’t walk. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子 When it is too cold to walk outside, they walk in a shopping mall. 当外面天气冷的时候，他们在商场步行，多以天气冷他们也步行。They don’t walk表述不对得知本题答案F。

questions.question: Two dogs follow them to walk every day. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子 A dog began to follow them. Soon, there were two more dogs.一只狗开始跟他们跑，不久后另外两只狗又加入了，所以应该是三只狗 得知本题答案F。

passages.content: Her first name is Alison. Her last name is Jones. Her phone number is five-four-five, six-five-five-four. His first name is Tom. His last name is Stovall. His phone number is seven-three-two, eight-six-nine-one. I am Mary Smith. My telephone number is seven-three-four, eight-five-nine-six.

questions.question: Her first name is Jones. (     )
questions.explanation: 【详解】Her first name is Alison.“她的名字叫艾莉森”。由此判断答案错误。

questions.question: His last name is Stovall. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子Her last name is Jones.“她姓约翰”。由此判断答案错误。

questions.question: Her last name is Jones. (     )
questions.explanation: 由句子Her last name is Jones.“她姓约翰”。由此判断答案正确。

questions.question: His phone number is 732-8691. (     )

passages.content:
I was born (出生) in a small river. When I was young, the river was my home. I did not know my father or mother, but I had many, many brothers and sisters. I swam and played with them.

At that time 1 did not look like my father or mother. I had no legs, but I had a long tail (尾巴). So I looked like a fish.

Then my tail became shorter and shorter (变得越来越短). And now I have four legs and a very short tail.

I know I’m going to have no tail at all soon (不久). I’m going to be like my father and mother. Then I’m going to jump out of the water. I’m going to live on the land (陆地) and in the water too. I’m going to eat a lot of insects (昆虫)—a lot of bad insects.

questions.question: The river was my home when I was born. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：当我出生时河流是我的家。根据文中句子I was born (出生）in a small river.可知我在一条小河里出生，故答案为T。

questions.question: I had no father or mother, but I had many brothers and sisters. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：我没有爸爸和妈妈，但是我有许多兄弟姐妹。根据文中句子I did not know my father or mother, but I had many, many brothers and sisters. 可知我不知道我的爸爸和妈妈，但是我有许多许多的兄弟姐妹。不知道不代表没有，故答案为F。

questions.question: I was a fish when I was young. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：当我小的时候我是一条鱼。通过通读全文可知，本文描述的是小蝌蚪变成青蛙的成长经过，青蛙小时是蝌蚪，故答案为F。

questions.question: I’m going to look like my father and mother. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：我将看起来像我的爸爸和妈妈。根据文中句子I’m going to be like my father and mother.可知我开始长得像爸爸妈妈了。故答案为T。

questions.question: I’m an insect. (      )
questions.explanation: 句意：我是一个昆虫。Insect是昆虫的意思，青蛙(frog)是动物不是昆虫，故答案为F。

passages.content: My friend, Jack works hard in a factory during the weekdays. At the weekends he always does different things. On Saturdays he goes fishing and on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car. His uncle and aunt have a farm there. It isn’t a big one, but there’s always much to do on the farm. The children help them with the animals and give them their food. Jack and his wife help them in the fields. At the end of the day, they are all tired and Jack’s aunt give them a big meal.

questions.question: Jack works hard in a factory on weekdays. (      )
questions.explanation: 由Jack works hard in a factory during the weekdays.可知本题是正确的，故填T。

questions.question: I usually does different things on the weekend. (      )
questions.explanation: 由At the weekends he always does different things.可知是he即Jack，而不是I ，故填F。

questions.question: Jack’s uncle and aunt live in the village. (      )
questions.explanation: 由on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car.和His uncle and aunt have a farm there.可知本题是正确的，故填T。

questions.question: Jack goes fishing and to a village with his family. (      )
questions.explanation: 由On Saturdays he goes fishing and on Sundays he goes to a village with his family by car.可知这两件事不是在同一在完成的，故本题是错误的，填F。

questions.question: Jack’s aunt’s farmis big. (      )
questions.explanation: 由It isn’t a big one.可知农场并不大，故填F。

passages.content:
Long long ago, there was a poor (穷) man. He had an orange tree. On the tree, there were many fine oranges. One of them was very big. It was as big as a ball. Nobody saw so big an orange. The poor man was very happy. He gave it to the King (国王). The King was so glad that he gave the man a lot of money for it.

When a rich man heard of it, he said to himself, “It was only an orange. Why did the King give so much money for him? I would take my gold (金的) cup to the King. He would give me more money.”

The next day when the King got the gold cup, he said to the rich man, “What a beautiful cup! I would show you something wonderful. This big orange is for you.”

questions.question: The rich man had an apple tree. (     )
questions.explanation: 【解析】题干意思：这个富人有一棵苹果树。由句子Long long ago, there was a poor(穷)man.He had an orange tree. （很久以前，有一个穷人。他有一棵橘子树。）可知本题错误，即F。

questions.question: One of the oranges was round and big as a ball. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意思：其中的一个句子很圆而且和球一样大。由句子One of them was very big. It was as big as a ball.（他们其中的一个很大。和球一样大。）可知本题正确，即T。

questions.question: The rich man wanted the big orange. (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意思：这个富人想要这个大橘子。由句子I would take my gold (金的)cup to the King. He would give me more money.（我把我的金杯带去给国王。他肯定会给我更多的钱。）可知答案是F。

questions.question: The rich man was not happy at last (最后). (     )
questions.explanation: 题干意思：最后这个富人很不高兴。 由句子I would take my gold (金的)cup to the King. He would give me more money. （我把我的金杯带去给国王。他肯定会给我更多的钱。）这是这个富人想的。和句子：The next day when the King got the gold cup, he said to the rich man, “What a beautiful cup! I would show you something wonderful. This big orange is for you.”（第二天国王得到了这个金杯，他对富人说“多么漂亮的杯子！我将要给你一些很棒的东西。这个大橘子给你。）可知富人没有得到他想要的更多钱，他肯定不高兴。所以本题答案是T。
